_comment: לוח תרי״ג המצוות — רשימת הרמב״ם בפתיחת משנה תורה (מספור: עשה 1–248, לא תעשה 1–365). עברית: Wikisource Mishneh Torah (CC-BY-SA). אנגלית: Mishneh Torah, trans. Eliyahu Touger, Moznaim (CC-BY-NC). הסבר נרחב לכל מצווה יגיע מספר החינוך.

versions.title: Mishneh Torah, trans. by Eliyahu Touger. Jerusalem, Moznaim Pub. c1986-c2007

items.en: To know that there is a God
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "אָנֹכִי ה' אֱלֹהֶיךָ" (שמות כ ב, דברים ה ו).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:2] states: "I am God, your Lord."

items.en: To unify Him
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "ה' אֱלֹהֵינוּ, ה' אֶחָד" (דברים ו, ד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 6:4] states: "God is our Lord, God is one."

items.en: To love Him
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְאָהַבְתָּ, אֵת ה' אֱלֹהֶיךָ" (דברים ו ה, יא א).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 6:5] states: "And you shall love God, your Lord."

items.en: To fear Him
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "אֶת-ה' אֱלֹהֶיךָ תִּירָא" (דברים ו יג, י כ).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 6:13] states: "Fear God, your Lord."

items.en: To pray
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וַעֲבַדְתֶּם, אֵת ה' אֱלֹהֵיכֶם" (שמות כג, כה) – עֲבוֹדָה זוֹ תְּפִלָּה.
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:25] states: "And you shall serve God, your Lord." This service is prayer.

items.en: To cling to Him
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וּבוֹ תִדְבָּק" (דברים י כ).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 10:20] states: "And you shall cling to Him."

items.en: To swear in His name
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וּבִשְׁמוֹ, תִּשָּׁבֵעַ" (דברים ו יג, י כ).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 10:20] states: "And you shall swear in His name."

items.en: To emulate His good and just ways
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְהָלַכְתָּ, בִּדְרָכָיו" (דברים כח, ט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 28:9] states: "And you shall walk in His ways."

items.en: To sanctify His name
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְנִקְדַּשְׁתִּי, בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל" (ויקרא כב, לב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:32] states: "And I shall be sanctified amidst the children of Israel."

items.he: לִקְרוֹת קִרְיַת שְׁמַע פַּעֲמַיִם בְּכָל יוֹם
items.en: To recite the Shema twice daily
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ" (דברים ו, ז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 6:7] states: "And you shall speak of them when you lie down and when you arise."

items.en: To study Torah and to teach it [to others]
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ" (דברים ו, ז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 6:7] states: "And you shall teach them to your children."

items.en: To tie tefillin upon our heads
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶיךָ" (דברים ו, ח).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 6:8] states: "And they shall be an emblem between your eyes."

items.en: To tie tefillin upon our arms
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל יָדֶךָ" (דברים ו, ח).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 6:8] states: "And you shall tie them for a sign upon your arms."

items.en: To make tzitzit
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת" (במדבר טו, לח).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 15:38] states: "And you shall make tzitzit for them."

items.en: To affix a mezuzah
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל מְזוּזֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ" (דברים ו ט; יא, כ).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 6:9] states: "And you shall write them on the doorposts of your home."

items.he: לְהַקְהִיל אֶת הָעָם לִשְׁמֹעַ תּוֹרָה בְּמוֹצָאֵי שְׁבִיעִית
items.en: To collect the people to hear the Torah [being read] in the year following the shemitah year
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "הַקְהֵל אֶת הָעָם..." (דברים לא, יב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 31:12] states: "Gather together the people."

items.he: לִכְתֹּב כָּל אִישׁ סֵפֶר תּוֹרָה לְעַצְמוֹ
items.en: For each man to write a Torah scroll for himself
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "כִּתְבוּ לָכֶם אֶת הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת" (דברים לא, יט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 31:19] states: "Write down this song."

items.he: לִכְתֹּב הַמֶּלֶךְ סֵפֶר תּוֹרָה לְעַצְמוֹ, יָתֵר עַל הָאֶחָד שֶׁלְּכָל אָדָם, עַד שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לוֹ שְׁתֵּי תּוֹרוֹת
items.en: For the king to write a second Torah scroll for himself in addition to the one
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְכָתַב לוֹ אֵת מִשְׁנֵה הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת" (דברים יז, יח).
items.srcEn: which [he is required to write to fulfill the mitzvah incumbent upon] every man. Thus, he will have two Torah scrolls, as [Deuteronomy 17:19] states: "And he shall write for himself a copy of this Torah."

items.en: To bless [God] after eating
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ וּבֵרַכְתָּ אֶת יְיָ אֱלֹהֶיךָ" (דברים ח, י).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 8:10] states: "[After] you eat and are satisfied, you shall bless God, your Lord."

items.en: To build [God's] chosen house, [the Temple,]
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְעָשׂוּ לִי מִקְדָּשׁ" (שמות כה, ח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 25:8] states: "And you shall make a sanctuary for Me."

items.en: To revere this house
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וּמִקְדָּשִׁי תִּירָאוּ" (ויקרא יט ל; כו, ב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:30] states: "And revere My sanctuary."

items.en: To keep watch over this house continuously
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְאַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל הָעֵדֻת" (במדבר יח, ב).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 18:2,4] states: "And you and- your descendants before the Tent of Testimony.... [And they shall keep the watch....]"

items.en: For the Levites to serve in the sanctuary
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְעָבַד הַלֵּוִי הוּא" (במדבר יח, כג).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 18:23] states: "And the Levite shall serve...."

items.he: לְקַדֵּשׁ הַכּוֹהֵן יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו בִּשְׁעַת הָעֲבוֹדָה
items.en: For a priest to sanctify his hands and feet at the time of service [in the Temple]
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְרָחֲצוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו..." (שמות ל, יט).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 30:19] states: "And Aaron and his sons will wash...."

items.en: To prepare the candles of the Sanctuary
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "יַעֲרֹךְ אֹתוֹ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו" (שמות כז, כא).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 27:21] states: "Aaron and his sons shall prepare it."

items.en: For the priests to bless the Jews
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "כֹּה תְבָרְכוּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל" (במדבר ו, כג).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 6:23] states: "In this manner, you shall bless the children of Israel."

items.he: לְהַסְדִּיר לֶחֶם וּלְבוֹנָה לִפְנֵי ה' בְּכָל שַׁבָּת
items.en: To arrange bread and frankincense before God [in the Temple] on every Sabbath
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְנָתַתָּ עַל הַשֻׁלְחָן לֶחֶם פָּנִים" (שמות כה, ל).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 25:30] states: "And you shall place the showbread on the table."

items.en: To burn a spice offering twice [each] day
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְהִקְטִיר עָלָיו אַהֲרֹן קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים" (שמות ל, ז).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 30:7] states: "And Aaron shall burn incense upon it...."

items.en: To keep a fire burning on the altar for burnt offerings continually
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "אֵשׁ תמיד תוקד על המזבח" (ויקרא ו, ו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 6:6] states: "And you shall keep a fire burning continuously on the altar."

items.he: לְהָרִים הַדֶּשֶׁן מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בְּכָל יוֹם
items.en: To remove the ashes from the altar
items.srcHe: שֶׁנֶּאֱמָר: "וְהֵרִים אֶת הַדֶּשֶׁן" (ויקרא ו, ג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 6:3] states: "And he shall remove the ashes...."

items.he: לשלח טמאים ממחנה שכינה שהוא המקדש
items.en: To send impure people out from the camp of the Divine Presence - i.e., the sanctuary -
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וִישַׁלְּחוּ מִן הַמַּחֲנֶה כָּל צָרוּעַ וְכָל זָב וְכֹל טָמֵא לָנֶפֶשׁ" (במדבר ה, ב).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 5:2] states: "And you shall send from the camp all the leprous, any zav, and anyone who has contracted impurity because of a corpse."

items.he: לחלוק כבוד לזרעו של אהרן, ולהקדימו לכל דבר שבקדושה
items.en: To show honor to Aaron's descendants and to give them priority regarding all holy matters
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ" (ויקרא כא, ח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:8] states: "And you shall sanctify him."

items.he: להיות הכהנים לובשים לעבודה בגדי כהונה
items.en: To clothe the priests with the priestly garments for service [in the Temple]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְעָשִׂיתָ בִגְדֵי קֹדֶשׁ..." (שמות כח, ב).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 28:2] states: "And you shall make holy garments...."

items.he: לשאת הארון על הכתף כשנושאין אותו
items.en: To carry the ark upon our shoulders when it is to be carried
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "בַּכָּתֵף יִשָּׂאוּ" (במדבר ז, ט).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 7:9] states: "And they shall carry it on their shoulders."

items.he: למשוח כהנים גדולים ומלכים בשמן המשחה
items.en: To anoint the High Priests and kings with the anointing oil
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה זֶה" (שמות ל, לא).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 30:30-31] states: "[Anoint Aaron....] This shall be sacred anointing oil."

items.he: להיות הכהנים עובדין במקדש משמרות משמרות, ובמועדים עובדין כאחד
items.en: For the priests to serve in the sanctuary in individual watches; and for them to all serve as one on the festivals
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְכִי יָבוֹא הַלֵּוִי..." (דברים יח, ו) "לְבַד מִמְכָּרָיו עַל הָאָבוֹת" (שם, ח).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 18:6-8] states: "When the Levite shall come... [he can serve]...with the exception of that which is theirs by ancestral right."

items.he: להיות הכהנים מיטמאין לקרוביהם, ומתאבלין עליהן כשאר ישראל שהן מצווין להתאבל
items.en: For the priests to become ritually impure and mourn for their relatives in the same manner as other Jews who are commanded to mourn
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "לָהּ יִטַּמָּא" (ויקרא כא, ג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:3] states: "He shall become impure for her."

items.en: For a High Priest to marry a virgin
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְהוּא אִשָּׁה בִּבְתוּלֶיהָ יִקָּח" (ויקרא כא, יג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:13] states: "And he shall marry a woman who is a virgin."

items.en: To offer the tamid offerings each day
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "שְׁנַיִם לַיּוֹם עוֹלָה תָמִיד" (במדבר כח, ג).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 28:3] states: "[This is the fire offering...] two each day continuously."

items.he: להקריב כהן גדול מנחה בכל יום
items.en: For the High Priest to offer a meal offering each day
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "זֶה קָרְבַּן אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו" (ויקרא ו, יג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 6:13] states: "This is the sacrifice of Aaron and his descendants."

items.en: To offer an additional sacrifice every Sabbath
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וּבְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת שְׁנֵי כְּבָשִׂים" (במדבר כח, ט).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 28:9] states: "On the Sabbath day, two lambs...."

items.he: להוסיף קרבן בכל ראש חודש וחודש
items.en: To offer an additional sacrifice every Rosh Chodesh
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וּבְרָאשֵׁי חָדְשֵׁיכֶם תַּקְרִיבוּ..." (במדבר כח, יא).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 28:11] states: "On your Rashei Chodashim...."

items.en: To offer an additional sacrifice on Pesach
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תַּקְרִיבוּ אִשֶּׁה לַיי" (ויקרא כג, לו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:36] states: "For seven days, you will bring a fire offering unto God...."1There is a slight difficulty with the Rambam's statements: The verse cited refers to the sacrifices offered on Sukkot, and not those offered on Pesach. Perhaps the intended prooftext is Leviticus 23:8: "And you shall offer a burnt offering for God for seven days."

items.he: להקריב מנחת העומר ממחרת יום ראשון של פסח עם כבש אחד
items.en: To bring the meal offering of the omer on the day after the first day of Pesach together with a single lamb
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וַהֲבֵאתֶם אֵת עֹמֶר רֵאשִׁית קְצִירְכֶם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן" (ויקרא כג, י).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:10] states: "And you shall bring the omer...."

items.en: To offer an additional sacrifice on Shavuot
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וּבְיוֹם הַבִּכּוּרִים..." (במדבר כח, כו) "וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עוֹלָה לְרֵיחַ..." (במדבר כח, כז).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 28:26] states: "On the day of the first fruits [Bikkurim]...."

items.he: להביא שתי הלחם עם הקרבנות הקרבים בגלל הלחם ביום עצרת
items.en: To bring two loaves and the sacrifices which accompany the loaves on Shavuot
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "מִמּוֹשְׁבוֹתֵיכֶם תָּבִיאוּ לֶחֶם תְּנוּפָה" (ויקרא כג, יז) "וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עַל הַלֶּחֶם" (שם, יח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:17] states: "From your dwellings, bring bread as a wave offering. And you shall offer upon the bread...."

items.en: To offer an additional sacrifice on Rosh HaShanah
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ [...] וַעֲשִׂיתֶם..." (במדבר כט, א).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 29:1] states: "And in the seventh month, on the first of the month...."

items.en: To offer an additional sacrifice on the fast [of Yom Kippur]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וּבֶעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי..." (במדבר כט, ז).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 29:7] states: "On the tenth of the seventh month...."

items.en: To carry out the service of the fast [of Yom Kippur]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "בְּזֹאת יָבֹא אַהֲרֹן אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּפַר בֶּן בָּקָר" (ויקרא טז, ג), וכל העבודה הכתובה בפרשת "אחרי מות".
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 16:3] states: "In this manner, Aaron will enter the [inner] sanctuary, with a young bull...." All the [particulars of] this service are stated in the parashah of Acharei Mot.

items.en: To offer an additional sacrifice on the holiday of Sukkot
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עוֹלָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ" (במדבר כט, יג).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 29:13] states: "And you shall present a burnt offering as a pleasing fragrance...."

items.he: להוסיף קרבן ביום שמיני עצרת, כי רגל בפני עצמו הוא
items.en: To offer an additional sacrifice on Shemini Atzeret, for it is a festival in its own right
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי" (במדבר כט, לה).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 29:35] states: "And on the eighth day....

items.en: To celebrate on the festivals
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "שָׁלֹשׁ רְגָלִים תָּחֹג לִי" (שמות כג, יד).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:14] states: "And you shall celebrate three festivals for Me."

items.en: To appear [before God in the Temple] on the festivals
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה יֵרָאֶה כָּל זְכוּרְךָ" (שמות כג יז; שם לג, כג; דברים טז טז.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 16:16] states: "On three occasions during the year, all your males shall appear...."

items.en: To rejoice on the festivals
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְשָׂמַחְתָּ בְּחַגֶּךָ" (דברים טז, יד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 16:14] states: "And you shall rejoice on your festivals."

items.en: To slaughter the Paschal lamb
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְשָׁחֲטוּ אֹתוֹ כָּל קְהַל " (שמות יב, ו).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:6] states: "And the entire congregation shall slaughter it...."

items.he: לאכול בשר הפסח צלי בלילי חמישה עשר מניסן
items.en: To eat the meat of the Paschal sacrifice roasted on the night of the fifteenth of Nisan
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְאָכְלוּ אֶת הַבָּשָׂר" (שמות יב, ח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:8] states: "And they shall eat the meat...."

items.en: To offer the second Paschal sacrifice
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר" (במדבר ט, יא).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 9:11] states: "In the second month, on the fourteenth of the month...."

items.he: לאכול את בשר פסח שני על מצה ומרור
items.en: To eat the meat of the second Paschal offering together with matzot and bitter herbs
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "עַל מַצּוֹת וּמְרוֹרִים יֹאכְלוּהוּ" (במדבר ט, יא).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 9:11] states: "And you shall eat it with matzot and bitter herbs."

items.he: לתקוע בחצוצרות על הקרבנות ובשעת הצרות
items.en: To sound the trumpets when the sacrifices [are offered] and in times of difficulty
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וּתְקַעְתֶּם בַּחֲצוֹצְרֹת" (במדבר י, י).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 10:10] states: "And you shall sound the trumpets...."

items.he: להיות כל קרבנות בהמה מיום שמיני והלאה
items.en: For all animals to be sacrificed after their eighth day [of life]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "מִיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי וָהָלְאָה" (ויקרא כב, כז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:27] states: "And on the eighth day and afterwards...."

items.en: For all animal offerings to be unblemished
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "תָּמִים יִהְיֶה לְרָצוֹן" (ויקרא כב, כא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:21] states: "[When it is] unblemished, it will be desirable...."

items.en: To salt all the sacrifices
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "עַל כָּל קָרְבָּנְךָ תַּקְרִיב מֶלַח" (ויקרא ב, יג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 2:13] states: "Offer salt on all your sacrifices."

items.en: The burnt offering
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "אִם עוֹלָה קָרְבָּנוֹ" (ויקרא א, ג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 1:3] states:"If his is a burnt offering...."

items.en: The sin offering
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַחַטָּאת" (ויקרא ו, יח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 6:18] states: "These are the laws of the sin offering...."

items.en: The guilt offering
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "זֹאת תּוֹרַת הָאָשָׁם" (ויקרא ז, א).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 7:1] states: "These are the laws of the guilt offering...."

items.en: The peace offering
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים" (ויקרא ז, יא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 7:11] states: "These are the laws of the peace offering...."

items.en: The meal offering
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תַקְרִיב קָרְבַּן מִנְחָה" (ויקרא ב, א).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 2:1] states: "When a person presents a meal offering...."

items.he: להקריב בית דין קרבן אם טעו בהוראה
items.en: For the [High] Court to offer a sacrifice if it renders an erroneous decision
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְאִם כָּל עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁגּוּ" (ויקרא ד, יג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 4:13] states: "If the entire congregation of Israel shall err...."

items.he: להקריב היחיד קרבן חטאת אם שגג במצות לא תעשה שחייבים עליה כרת
items.en: For each individual to offer a sin offering if he unintentionally violates a negative commandment punishable by karet2Karet refers to premature death at the hand of God, the death of one's children, and a severe spiritual punishment for the soul. (See Hilchot Teshuvah 8:1.)
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא" (ויקרא ה, א).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 5:1] states: "When a person sins...."3Though this prooftext is quoted in the printed editions of the Mishneh Torah, it appears to be an error, for the passage it introduces deals with the adjustable guilt offering (Positive Mitzvah 72). The verse which introduces the laws of the sin offerings is Leviticus 4:27: "If one person sins...."

items.he: להקריב היחיד קרבן אם נסתפק לו אם חטא חטא שחייבים עליו חטאת או לא חטא
items.en: For an individual to offer a sacrifice if he is in doubt whether or not he transgressed a prohibition for which he would be liable for a sin offering
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְלֹא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ" (ויקרא ה, יז) וזה הוא נקרא אשם תלוי.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 5:17-18] states: "If he does not know, he still bears responsibility...and he shall bring his guilt offering." This is referred to as "the conditional guilt offering."

items.he: להקריב השוגג במעילה, או החוטא בגזילה, או בשפחה חרופה, או שכפר בפיקדון ונשבע; מביא קרבן אשם, וזה הוא הנקרא אשם ודאי
items.en: For [the following individuals:] a person who unknowingly used sacred property, a person who sinned by stealing, one [who had relations with] a maidservant designated for another person, or one who denied possession of an entrusted object and took a [false] oath, to bring a guilt offering. This is referred to as "the unconditional guilt offering."4Perhaps the Rambam does not cite a specific prooftext for this mitzvah because there is a different passage in the Torah which deals with each of the guilt offerings which he mentions
To offer "the adjustable guilt offering" [as atonement for the violation of certain transgressions]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ואם לא תגיע ידו" (ויקרא ה,ז), "ואם לא תשיג ידו" (ויקרא ה,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 5:1,11] states: "If his means are not sufficient.... If his means do not suffice...."

items.he: להתוודות לפני ה' מכל חטא שיעשה האדם, בשעת הקרבן ושלא בשעת הקרבן
items.en: For a person to confess before God for any sin which he has committed. [This applies] when he brings a sacrifice [for atonement] and when he does not bring a sacrifice
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "והתוודו, את חטאתם אשר עשו" (במדבר ה,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 5:6] states: "And they shall confess the sins that they committed."5Note that in Hilchot Teshuvah, the Rambam defines this mitzvah as return to God and repentance, a more encompassing service, of which confession is only one facet.(See Hilchot Teshuvah 2:2.)

items.en: For a zav to offer a sacrifice when he becomes purified [after his affliction]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וכי יטהר הזב, מזובו" (ויקרא טו,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 15:13] states: "When a zav will become pure...."

items.en: For a zavah to offer a sacrifice when she be-comes purified [after her affliction]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ואם טהרה, מזובה" (ויקרא טו,כח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 15:28] states: "When she becomes pure from [the condition] of zavah...."

items.en: For a woman who gave birth to offer a sacrifice after she becomes purified
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ובמלאות ימי טהרה" (ויקרא יב,ו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 12:6] states: "And after the conclusion of her pure days...."

items.en: For a person afflicted with tzara’at to offer a sacrifice after he becomes purified
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וביום השמיני ייקח" (ויקרא יד,י).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 14:1] states: "On the eighth day, he shall take...."

items.en: To tithe one's herds
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וכל מעשר בקר וצאן" (ויקרא כז,לב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 27:32] states: "And all the tithes of your cattle and sheep...."

items.en: To sanctify the firstborn of a kosher animal and offer it as a sacrifice
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כל הבכור אשר יולד" (דברים טו,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 15:19] states: "Every firstling which shall be born...."

items.en: To redeem firstborn sons
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "אך פדה תפדה, את בכור האדם" (במדבר יח,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 18:15] states: "However, you must surely redeem first-born humans."

items.en: To redeem a firstling donkey
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ופטר חמור תפדה בשה" (שמות לד,כ).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 34:20] states: "Redeem a firstling donkey with a sheep."

items.en: To decapitate a firstling donkey [which is not redeemed]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ואם לא תפדה וערפתו" (שמות יג,יג; שמות לד,כ).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 34:20] states: "If you do not redeem it, you must decapitate it."

items.he: להביא כל הקרבנות שיש על האדם בחובה או בנדבה ברגל ראשון שפגע בו
items.en: For a person to bring all the sacrifices for which he is liable, be they obligatory or voluntary offerings, on the first pilgrimage festival that occurs
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ובאת שמה" (דברים יב,ה), "והבאתם שמה" (דברים יב,ו).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 12:5-6] states: "And you shall come there... and you shall bring there...."

items.en: To sacrifice all the offerings in [God's] chosen house, [i.e., the Temple,]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ושם תעשה, כול אשר אנוכי מצווך" (דברים יב,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 12:14] states: "There, you will perform all that I command you."

items.he: להיטפל בהבאת הקרבנות מחוצה לארץ לבית הבחירה
items.en: To tend to all the offerings from the Diaspora and bring them to Eretz [Yisrael], to [God's] chosen house, [i.e., the Temple,]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "רק קודשיך אשר יהיו לך, ונדריך, תישא ובאת" (דברים יב,כו); מפי השמועה למדו שאינו מדבר אלא בקודשי חוצה לארץ.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 12:26] states: "Take the sacred offerings which you possess, and your pledges, and come [to the place that God will choose]." Based on the oral tradition, we have learned that this applies to sacred offerings from the Diaspora.

items.he: לפדות קודשים בעלי מומים ויהיו מותרים באכילה
items.en: To redeem sacred offerings that have become blemished, and thus have them to be permitted [for mundane use]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "רק בכל אוות נפשך תזבח ואכלת בשר" (דברים יב,טו); מפי השמועה למדו שאינו מדבר אלא בפסולי המוקדשין שייפדו.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 12:15] states: "But whenever you desire, you may slaughter...." Based on the oral tradition, we have learned that this refers only to sacred offerings which have become disqualified and have been redeemed.

items.en: That an animal substituted for a sacred offering be regarded as sacred
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "והיה הוא ותמורתו יהיה קודש" (ויקרא כז,י; ויקרא כז,לג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 27:33] states: "Both [the original animal] and the one substituted for it shall be consecrated."

items.en: To eat the remains of the meal offerings
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "והנותרת ממנה, יאכלו אהרון ובניו" (ויקרא ו,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 6:9] states: "Aaron and his sons will eat the remainder of it."

items.en: To eat the flesh of the sin and guilt offerings,6In Sefer HaMitzvot, the Rambam includes eating other sacrifices and sacred foods in the scope of this mitzvah
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ואכלו אותם אשר כופר בהם" (שמות כט,לג).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 29:33] states: "And they shall eat [the sacrifices] with which atonement was made for them."

items.en: To burn sacred meat which became impure
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "והבשר אשר ייגע בכל טמא" (ויקרא ז,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 7:19] states: "And the flesh which touches anything impure... [shall be burnt]."

items.en: To burn the leftovers [from the sacrifices]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "והנותר, מבשר הזבח--ביום, השלישי, באש, יישרף" (ויקרא ז,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 7:17] states: "The leftovers from the flesh of the sacrifice shall be burnt with fire on the third day."

items.en: For a Nazirite to grow his hair long
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "גדל פרע, שיער ראשו" (במדבר ו,ה).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 6:5] states: "He shall let the hair of his head grow without cutting it."

items.he: לגלח הנזיר שערו על קרבנותיו במלאות ימי נזרו, או בתוך ימי נזרו אם נטמא
items.en: For a Nazarite to shave his hair when bringing his sacrifices at the conclusion of his term as a Nazirite, or during his Nazirite term if he becomes impure
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וכי ימות מת עליו" (במדבר ו,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 6:9] states: "Should a person die in his presence,... [he must shave....]"

items.he: לקיים אדם כל מה שהוציא בשפתיו, מקרבן או צדקה וכיוצא בהם
items.en: For a person to fulfill any [promise] which he utters, be it a sacrifice, [a gift to] charity, or the like
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "מוצא שפתיך, תשמור ועשית" (דברים כג,כד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:24] states: "What you have spoken, take heed to fulfill...."

items.he: לדון בהפרת נדרים בכל הדינים האמורין בפרשה
items.en: To carry out the laws regarding the nullification of vows, as mentioned in the Torah
For everyone who comes in contact with the corpse of an animal to become impure
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וכי ימות מן הבהמה" (ויקרא יא, לט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 11:39] states: "Should an animal die...."

items.en: For the [dead bodies of] the eight species of crawling animals [mentioned in the Torah] to impart ritual impurity
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וזה לכם הטמא" (ויקרא יא, כט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 11:19] states: "These shall be impure for you...."

items.en: For [certain] foods to impart impurity
items.srcHe: שנאמר "מכל האוכל אשר יאכל" (ויקרא יא, לד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 11:34] states: "From all the food which you will eat...."

items.en: For [a woman in the] niddah state to be impure and to impart impurity to others
For [a woman] who gives birth to be impure [like a woman] in the niddah state
For a person afflicted with tzara’at to be impure and to impart impurity
For a garment afflicted with tzara’at to be impure and to impart impurity
For a house afflicted with tzara’at to impart impurity
For a zav to impart impurity
For semen to impart impurity
For a zavah to impart impurity
For a corpse to impart impurity

items.he: להיות מי נדה מטמאין לאדם טהור, ומטהרין מטומאת מת בלבד. וכל אלו הדינין של טומאות אלו, רוב משפט כל טומאה וטומאה מהן מבואר בתורה שבכתב
items.en: For the sprinkling water [used for the purification process involving the red heifer] to impart impurity to a person who is ritually pure, and to impart ritual purity to a person who is ritually impure solely because of contact with a human corpse. All the laws dealing with these different types of impurity and the majority of the judgments regarding all types of ritual purity and impurity are explained explicitly in the Written Law.7It is somewhat curious that although the Rambam makes this statement, he does not cite prooftexts for these mitzvot

items.he: להיות הטהרה מכל הטמאות בטבילה במי מקוה
items.en: For the process of purification from all types of ritual impurity to involve immersion in the waters of a mikveh
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם אֶת כָּל בְּשָׂרוֹ" (ויקרא טו, טז) למדו מפי השמועה שרחיצה זו במים שכל גופו עולה בהן בבת אחת.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 15:16] states: "And he shall wash all his flesh in water." Based on the oral tradition, we have learned that this washing [involves immersion in a body of] water in which one's entire body can immerse at one time.

items.he: להיות הטהרה מן הצרעת בין צרעת אדם בין צרעת בית בעץ ארז ואיזוב ושני תולעת ושתי ציפורים ומים חיים
items.en: For the process of purification from tzara’at, be it a person afflicted with tzara’at or a house afflicted with tzara’at, [to involve] a staff of cedar, a hyssop, the crimson wool, two birds, and spring water
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "זֹאת תִּהְיֶה תּוֹרַת הַמְּצֹרָע" (ויקרא יד, ב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 14:2] states: "This shall be the purification process for the person afflicted with tzara’at...."

items.en: For a person afflicted with tzara’at to shave all of his hair
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יְגַלַּח אֶת כָּל שְׂעָרוֹ" (ויקרא יד, ט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 14:9] states: "And it shall be on the seventh day, he shall shave all his hair."

items.he: להיות המצורע ידוע לכל בדברים האמורים בו "בְּגָדָיו יִהְיוּ פְרֻמִים וְרֹאשׁוֹ יִהְיֶה פָרֻעַ וְעַל שָׂפָם יַעְטֶה וְטָמֵא טָמֵא יִקְרָא" (ויקרא יג, מה). וכן כל שאר הטמאים צריכין להודיע את עצמן
items.en: For a person afflicted with tzara’at to make known his condition to all others, according to the instructions mentioned in [Leviticus 13:45]: "His garments shall be torn, his hair shall grow uncut, he shall cover his face to the lip, and he shall cry out: `Impure! Impure!"' Similarly, all others who are ritually impure must make known their condition

items.he: לעשות פרה אדומה להיות אפרה מוכן
items.en: To prepare the red heifer so that its ashes will be ready
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְהָיְתָה לַעֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל" (במדבר יט, ט).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 19:9] states: "And it will be a keepsake for the congregation of Israel."

items.he: להיות מעריך אדם נותן דמים הקצובין בפרשה
items.en: For a person who makes an endowment valuation to give the specific amount of money stated in the [Torah] portion
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "אִישׁ כִּי יַפְלִא נֶדֶר" (ויקרא כז, ב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 27:2] states: "When a person expresses a vow...."

items.he: להיות מעריך בהמה טמאה נותן דמיה
items.en: For a person who makes an endowment valuation concerning a non-kosher animal to give [the required amount of] money
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְהֶעֱמִיד אֶת הַבְּהֵמָה" (ויקרא כז, יא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 27:11] states: "And he shall cause the animal to stand...."

items.he: להיות מעריך ביתו נותן כערך הכהן
items.en: For a person who makes an endowment valuation concerning his home to give the value determined by the priest
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְאִישׁ כִּי יַקְדִּישׁ" (ויקרא כז, יד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 27:14] states: "And the priest shall determine its value."

items.he: להיות מקדיש שדהו נותן בערך הקצוב בפרשה
items.en: For a person who consecrates his field to give the fixed amount determined by the [Torah]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ כְּפִי זַרְעוֹ" (ויקרא כז, טז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 27:16] states: "And the value you attach to it shall be according to the amount of seed."

items.he: לשלם השוגג במעילה מה שמעל לה' ולהוסיף חומש
items.en: For a person who unintentionally makes use of a sacred object to make restitution for what he misused [when] sinning against God, and for him to add one fifth of its value
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר חָטָא מִן הַקֹּדֶשׁ יְשַׁלֵּם" (ויקרא ה, טז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 5:17] states: "For that which he sinned, [using something] sacred, he shall pay...."

items.en: For the produce of the fourth year to be sacred
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "יִהְיֶה כָּל פִּרְיוֹ קֹדֶשׁ הִלּוּלִים" (ויקרא יט, כד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:24] states: "Its produce shall be sacred, [an object of] praise to God...."

items.en: To leave pe'ah
To leave leket
To leave a forgotten sheaf
To leave the incompletely formed grape clusters

items.he: להניח פרט הכרם לפי שבכל אלו נאמר "לֶעָנִי וְלַגֵּר תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָם" (ויקרא יט, י) (ויקרא כג, כב) וזו היא מצות עשה שלהם
items.en: To leave the individual fallen grapes. With regard to all these [five mitzvot], [Leviticus 19:10] states: "Leave them for the poor and the stranger." This [verse states] the positive commandment for all these.8In Sefer HaMitzvot, the Rambam notes that the command to leave a forgotten sheaf in the field is derived, not from this verse, but from Deuteronomy 24:19, which states: "When you reap your harvest... and forget a sheaf in the field..., it shall be for the stranger..."
To bring the first fruits to God's chosen house, [the Temple,]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "רֵאשִׁית בִּכּוּרֵי אַדְמָתְךָ" (שמות כג, יט) (שמות לד, כו).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:19] states: "The first fruits of your land...."

items.en: To separate the greater terumah [and give it] to the priest
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "רֵאשִׁית דְּגָנְךָ תִּתֵּן לוֹ" (דברים יח, ד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 18:4] states: "Give him the first of your grain."

items.en: To separate a tithe of grain [and give it] to the Levites
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כָּל מַעְשַׂר הָאָרֶץ" (ויקרא כז, ל).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 27:30] states: "All the land's tithes...."

items.he: להפריש מעשר שני להיאכל לבעליו בירושלים
items.en: To separate the second tithe so that it can be eaten by its owners in Jerusalem
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "עַשֵּׂר תְּעַשֵּׂר" (דברים יד, כב) מפי השמועה למדו שזה הוא מעשר שני.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 14:22] states: "You shall surely tithe...." According to the oral tradition, we learn that this refers to the second tithe.

items.he: להיות הלוים מפרישין מעשר מן המעשר שלקחו מישראל ונותנין אותו לכהנים
items.en: For the Levites to separate a tenth from the tenth which they took from the Israelites and give it to the priests
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְאֶל הַלְוִיִּם תְּדַבֵּר" (במדבר יח, כו).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 18:27] states: "Speak to the Levites:...."

items.he: להפריש מעשר עני תחת מעשר שני בשלישית ובשישית בשבוע
items.en: To separate the tithe for the poor instead of the second tithe in the third and sixth years of the seven-year [agricultural cycle]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "מִקְצֵה שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים תּוֹצִיא אֶת כָּל מַעְשַׂר תְּבוּאָתְךָ" (דברים יד, כח).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 14:28] states: "At the end of three years, remove a tithe of all your crops...."

items.en: To give thanks, [reciting] the declaration concerning the tithes
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ואמרת לפני ה' אלוהיך ביערתי הקודש" (דברים כו,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 26:13] states: "And you shall declare before God, your Lord, `I have removed the sacred [foods]...."'

items.en: To read the statement [acknowledging thanks] for the first fruits
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וענית ואמרת לפני ה' אלוהיך" (דברים כו,ה).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 26:5] states: "And you shall respond and say before God, your Lord:...."

items.en: To separate challah [and give it] to the priest
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ראשית, עריסותיכם--חלה, תרימו תרומה" (במדבר טו,כ).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 15:20] states: "The first of your dough, the challah, you shall separate as an offering...."

items.en: To let the land lie fallow [in the seventh year]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "והשביעית תשמטנה ונטשתה" (שמות כג,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:11] states: "In the seventh year, you shall let it lie fallow and withdraw from it."

items.en: To refrain from agricultural work [in the seventh year]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "בחריש ובקציר, תשבות" (שמות לד,כא).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 34:21] states: "From plowing and harvesting, you shall rest."

items.en: To sanctify the Jubilee year by refraining [from agricultural work], as is done in the shemitah
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וקידשתם, את שנת החמישים" (ויקרא כה,י).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:10] states: "And you shall sanctify the fiftieth year...."

items.en: To sound the shofar in the Jubilee year
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "והעברת שופר תרועה" (ויקרא כה,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:9] states: "And you shall sound the shofar blasts."

items.en: To free all land in the Jubilee year
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ובכול, ארץ אחוזתכם, גאולה, תיתנו לארץ" (ויקרא כה,כד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:24] states: "For all your ancestral lands, there will be redemption for the land."

items.he: להיות גאולה בבתי ערי חומה עד שנה
items.en: To allow houses in a walled city to be redeemed within a year
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ואיש, כי ימכור בית מושב" (ויקרא כה,כט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:29] states: "If a person shall sell a residential house in a walled city...."

items.en: To count the years of the Jubilee year and the shemitah years within it
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וספרת לך, שבע . . ." (ויקרא כה,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:8] states: "And you shall count seven shemitah years."

items.en: To remit all financial [obligations] in the seventh year
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "שמוט כל בעל משה ידו" (דברים טו,ב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 15:2] states: "Every creditor must remit...."

items.en: To seek to collect [a debt] from a gentile [in the seventh year]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "את הנוכרי, תיגוש; ואשר יהיה לך" (דברים טו,ג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 15:3] states: "Seek to collect [a debt] from a gentile. However, what your brother owes you must remit...."

items.he: ליתן מן הבהמה לכוהן הזרוע והלחיים והקיבה
items.en: To give a priest the shankbone, the jaw, and the maw from an animal [which is slaughtered]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ונתן, לכוהן, הזרוע" (דברים יח,ג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 18:3] states: "And you shall give the priest the shankbone...."

items.en: To give the first portion of the fleece to a priest
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וראשית גז צאנך--תיתן לו" (דברים יח,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 18:4] states: "Give him the first portion of the shearing of your sheep."

items.he: לדון בדיני חרמים, מהם לה' ומהם לכוהן
items.en: To render judgment with regard to property which is dedicated, whether dedicated to God or dedicated to the priests
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "אך כל חרם אשר יחרים" (ויקרא כז,כח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 27:28] states: "However, any dedication that will be made...."

items.he: לשחוט בהמה חיה ועוף ואחר כך יאכל בשרם
items.en: To slaughter an animal, beast, or fowl and afterwards to eat their meat
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וזבחת מבקרך ומצאנך" (דברים יב,כא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 12:21] states: "And you shall slaughter your cattle and your sheep."

items.en: To cover the blood of beasts and fowl [which are slaughtered]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ושפך, את דמו, וכיסהו, בעפר" (ויקרא יז,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 17:13] states: "And you shall pour out its blood and cover it with dust."

items.en: To send away [the mother bird] from the nest [when taking the young]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "שלח תשלח את האם ואת הבנים תיקח לך" (דברים כב,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:7] states: "You shall surely send away the mother."

items.en: To check the signs [with which] animals [are identified], as kosher
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "זאת החיה אשר תאכלו" (ויקרא יא,ב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 11:2] states: "These are the animals which you may eat...."

items.he: לבדוק בסימני העוף עד שיבדיל בין טמא לטהור
items.en: To check the signs of fowl in order to differentiate between one which is kosher and one which is not kosher
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כל ציפור טהורה, תאכלו" (דברים יד,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 14:11] states: "All birds which...."

items.he: לבדוק בסימני חגבים לידע טהור מן הטמא
items.en: To check the signs of grasshoppers in order to know which is kosher and which is not kosher
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "אשר לו כרעיים" (ויקרא יא,כא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 11:21] states: "Those which possess jointed [leg like] extensions...."

items.en: To check the signs [with which] fish [are identified as kosher]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "את זה, תאכלו, מכול, אשר במים" (ויקרא יא,ט; דברים יד,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 11:9] states: "These are the animals which you may eat from all that is found in water...."

items.he: לקדש חודשים ולחשב שנים וחודשים בבית דין בלבד
items.en: To sanctify the months and to calculate the years and months. [This mitzvah is incumbent on] the court alone
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "החודש הזה לכם, ראש חודשים" (שמות יב,ב).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:2] states: "This month will be for you the first of the months."

items.en: To rest on the Sabbath
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וביום השביעי תשבות" (שמות כג,יב; שמות לד,כא).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:12] states: "Rest on the seventh day...."

items.en: To sanctify the Sabbath
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "זכור את יום השבת, לקדשו" (שמות כ,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:8] states: "Remember the Sabbath day to keep it holy."

items.en: To destroy chametz [before Pesach]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ביום הראשון, תשביתו שאור מבתיכם" (שמות יב,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:15] states: "On the day before [the holiday], obliterate chametz from your homes."

items.he: לספר ביציאת מצריים בלילה הראשון של חג המצות
items.en: To relate the narrative of the exodus of Egypt on the first night of the Feast of Matzot
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "והגדת לבנך" (שמות יג,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 13:8] states: "And you shall tell your son on that day,...."

items.en: To eat matzah on this night
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "בערב, תאכלו, מצות" (שמות יב,יח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:18] states: "In the evening, you shall eat matzot."

items.en: To rest on the first day of Pesach
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וביום הראשון, מקרא קודש" (שמות יב,טז).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:16] states: "And on the first day, it shall be a sacred holiday."

items.en: To rest on the seventh day [of the festival]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וביום השביעי, מקרא קודש" (שמות יב,טז; במדבר כח,כה).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:16] states: "On the seventh day, there will be a sacred holiday."

items.he: לספור מקצירת העומר תשעה וארבעים יום
items.en: To count 49 days from the harvesting of the omer
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וספרתם לכם, ממחרת השבת" (ויקרא כג,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:15] states: "And you shall count from the day following the day of rest...."

items.en: To rest on the fiftieth day [after Pesach]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וקראתם בעצם היום הזה, מקרא קודש" (ויקרא כג,כא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:21] states: "And you shall proclaim a sacred holiday on that selfsame day."

items.en: To rest on the first day of the seventh month
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "באחד לחודש, יהיה לכם שבתון" (ויקרא כג,כד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:24] states: "On the first day of [this] month, you shall have a day of rest."

items.en: To fast on the tenth [of this month, Yom Kippur,]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ובעשור לחודש תענו את נפשותיכם" (ראה ויקרא טז,כט; במדבר כט,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 16:29] states: "On the tenth of the month, you shall afflict your souls."

items.en: To rest on [this] fast day
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "שבת שבתון" (ויקרא טז,לא; ויקרא כג,לב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 16:31] states: "It shall be a Sabbath of Sabbaths...."

items.en: To rest on the first day of the festival of Sukkot
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ביום הראשון, מקרא קודש" (ויקרא כג,לה).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:35] states: "On the first day, there shall be a sacred holiday."

items.en: To rest on the eighth day of the festival of Sukkot
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וביום השמיני מקרא קודש" (ראה ויקרא כג,לו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:36] states: "On the eighth day, there shall be a sacred holiday."

items.en: To dwell in a sukkah for seven days
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "בסוכות תשבו, שבעת ימים" (ויקרא כג,מב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:42] states: "And you shall dwell in sukkot for seven days."

items.en: To take the lulav [and the other three species on Sukkot]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ולקחתם לכם ביום הראשון, פרי עץ הדר כפות תמרים" (ויקרא כג,מ).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:40] states: "And you shall take for yourselves on the first day, the fruit of a beautiful tree, a palm branch,...."

items.en: To hear the sound of the shofar on Rosh HaShanah
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "יום תרועה, יהיה לכם" (במדבר כט,א).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 29:1] states: "It will be a day of [shofar] blasts for you."

items.he: ליתן מחצית השקל בכל שנה ושנה
items.en: To give a half-shekel each year
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "זה ייתנו, כל העובר על הפקודים" (שמות ל,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 30:13] states: "This shall be given by all those included in the census...."

items.he: לשמוע מכל נביא שיהיה בכל דור ודור אם לא יוסיף ולא יגרע
items.en: To listen to any prophet who will arise in any era, provided he does not add or detract [from the Torah's commandments]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "אליו, תשמעון" (דברים יח,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 18:15] states: "You shall listen to him."

items.en: To appoint a king
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "שום תשים עליך מלך" (דברים יז,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 17:15] states: "You shall surely set a king upon yourselves."

items.he: לשמוע מכל בית דין הגדול שיעמדו להם לישראל
items.en: To obey the High Court regarding all [the ordinances] they establish for Israel
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ועל המשפט אשר יאמרו לך--תעשה" (דברים יז,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 17:11] states: "Carry out the judgment which they render for you."

items.he: לנטות אחרי רבים אם תהיה מחלוקת בין הסנהדרין בדינין
items.en: To follow the majority if there is a difference of opinion in the Sanhedrin concerning a law
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "אחרי רבים--להטות" (שמות כג,ב).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:2] states: "Follow after the majority."

items.he: למנות שופטים ושוטרים בכל קהל וקהל מישראל
items.en: To appoint judges and court officers in each and every Jewish community
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "שופטים ושוטרים, תיתן לך" (דברים טז,יח).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 16:18] states: "Appoint judges and court officers...."

items.he: להשוות בין בעלי דינין בשעה שעומדין בדין
items.en: To treat litigants equally when they appear [in court] to be judged
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "בצדק, תשפוט עמיתך" (ויקרא יט,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:15] states: "Judge your fellow man with righteousness."

items.he: להעיד בבית דין למי שיש לו עדות
items.en: For anyone who has evidence to testify in court
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "והוא עד, או ראה או ידע" (ויקרא ה,א).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 5:1] states: "If he was a witness, saw, or knew...."

items.en: To cross-examine the witnesses thoroughly
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ודרשת וחקרת ושאלת, היטב" (דברים יג,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 13:15] states: "You must investigate and probe, making careful enquiry."

items.he: לעשות לעדים זוממין כמו שזממו לעשות
items.en: To [punish] false witnesses [by] giving them the same penalty that they wish to have imposed [on the defendant]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ועשיתם לו, כאשר זמם" (דברים יט,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 19:19] states: "And you shall do to him what he plotted to do to his brother."

items.en: To decapitate the calf [brought as atonement for an unsolved murder] as required
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וערפו שם את העגלה, בנחל" (דברים כא,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 21:4] states: "You shall decapitate the calf there in the river."

items.en: To prepare six refuge cities
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "תכין לך, הדרך, ושילשת" (דברים יט,ג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 19:3] states: "Prepare the way and divide into three [the boundary]...."

items.he: לתת ללויים ערים לשבת, וגם הן קולטות
items.en: To give the Levites cities in which to dwell - they also serve as refuge centers -
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ונתנו ללויים . . . ערים" (במדבר לה,ב).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 35:2] states: "And you shall give cities to the Levites...."

items.en: To construct a guard rail
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ועשית מעקה לגגך" (דברים כב,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:8] states: "And you shall construct a guard rail for your roof."

items.en: To destroy false gods and all their objects of worship
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "אבד תאבדון את כל המקומות" (דברים יב,ב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 12:2] states: "You shall surely destroy...."

items.he: להרוג אנשי עיר הנידחת ולשרוף את העיר
items.en: To slay the inhabitants of an apostate city and burn the city
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ושרפת באש את . . . כל שללה" (דברים יג,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 13:17] states: "And you shall burn the city and all its spoil with fire."

items.en: To destroy the seven nations [that dwelled in] Eretz Yisrael
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "החרם תחרימם" (דברים כ,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 20:17] states: "You shall utterly destroy them."

items.en: To exterminate the seed of Amalek
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "תמחה את זכר עמלק" (דברים כה,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 25:19] states: "Blot out the memory of Amalek."

items.he: לזכור מה שעשה לנו עמלק תדיר
items.en: To constantly remember what Amalek did to us
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "זכור, את אשר עשה לך עמלק" (דברים כה,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 25:17] states: "Remember what Amalek did to you."

items.he: לעשות במלחמת הרשות כמשפט הכתוב בתורה
items.en: To wage a voluntary war according to the laws prescribed by the Torah
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כי תקרב אל עיר" (דברים כ,י).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 20:10] states: "When you approach the city...."

items.en: To anoint a priest [who will address the people before] battle
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "והיה, כקרבכם אל המלחמה; וניגש הכוהן" (דברים כ,ב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 20:2] states: "And it shall come to pass, when you approach the battle, the priest will come forward and speak to the people...."

items.en: To prepare a place [outside] the [army] camp [for use as a latrine]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ויד תהיה לך, מחוץ למחנה" (דברים כג,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:13] states: "Prepare a place for yourselves outside the camp."

items.en: To prepare a shovel [to cover one's excrement]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ויתד תהיה לך, על אזנך" (דברים כג,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:14] states: "You shall have a shovel in addition to your weapons."

items.en: To return a stolen object
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "והשיב את הגזילה אשר גזל" (ויקרא ה,כג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 5:23] states: "And he shall return the object which he stole."

items.en: To give charity
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "פתוח תפתח את ידך" (דברים טו,ח; דברים טו,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 15:8] states: "You shall surely open your hand [to your poor brother]."

items.en: To give a severance gift to a Hebrew servant
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "הענק תעניק, לו" (דברים טו,יד); וכן אמה עברייה.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 15:14] states: "You shall surely give him gifts...." Similarly, [this gift is given] to a Hebrew maidservant.

items.en: To lend to the poor
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "אם כסף תלווה את עמי" (שמות כב,כד); "אם" זה אינו רשות אלא מצוה, שנאמר: "והעבט, תעביטנו" (דברים טו,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:24] states: "If you will lend money to my people...." In this instance, the word "if" does not refer to a matter left to one's volition, but to a commandment, as [Deuteronomy 15:8] states: "You shall surely lend him."

items.en: To lend to a gentile at interest
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "לנוכרי תשיך" (דברים כג,כא); מפי השמועה למדו שזו מצות עשה.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:21] states: "Take interest from a gentile." Based on the oral tradition, we have learned that this is a positive commandment.

items.en: To return security to its owner
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "השב תשיב לו את העבוט" (דברים כד,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:13] states: "You shall surely return the security to him."

items.en: To pay a worker his wage on time
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ביומו תיתן שכרו" (דברים כד,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:15] states: "Pay him his wage on the day it is due."

items.en: For a hired worker to be allowed to eat [from produce] while he is working with it
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כי תבוא בכרם ריעך" (דברים כג,כה), "כי תבוא בקמת ריעך" (דברים כג,כו).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:25-26] states: "When you enter your neighbor's vineyard... When you enter your neighbor's standing grain...."

items.he: לעזוב מעל חברו או מעל בהמתו
items.en: To assist a colleague in unloading a burden which he or his beast [is carrying]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "עזוב תעזוב, עימו" (שמות כג,ה).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:5] states: "You shall surely help him."

items.en: To [help a colleague] load a burden unto a beast
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "הקם תקים, עימו" (דברים כב,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:4] states: " You shall lift it up with him."

items.en: To return a lost object
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "השב תשיבם, לאחיך" (דברים כב,א).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:1] states: "You shall surely return them to your brother."

items.en: To rebuke a person who sins
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "הוכח תוכיח את עמיתך" (ויקרא יט,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:17] states: "You shall surely rebuke your fellow men."

items.he: לאהוב כל בני אדם מבני ברית
items.en: To love every member of our people
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ" (ויקרא יט, יח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:18] states: "And you shall love your neighbor as yourself."

items.en: To love a convert
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ואהבתם את הגר" (דברים י, יט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 10:19] states: "And you shall love a convert."

items.en: To balance scales with correct weights
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "מאזני צדק אבני צדק" (ויקרא יט, לו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:36] states: "You shall have correct scales, with correct weights."

items.en: To honor the Sages
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "מפני שיבה תקום" (ויקרא יט, לב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:32] states: "Rise before an elder."

items.en: To honor one's father and mother
items.srcHe: שנאמר "כַּבֵּד אֶת אָבִיךָ וְאֶת אִמֶּךָ" (שמות כ, יא); (דברים ה, טו).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:12] states: "Honor your father and mother."

items.en: To fear one's father and mother
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "אִישׁ אִמּוֹ וְאָבִיו תִּירָאוּ" (ויקרא יט, ג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:3] states: "A person must fear his mother and his father."

items.en: To be fruitful and multiply
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "פרו ורבו" (בראשית ט, ז).
items.srcEn: as [Genesis 9:7] states: "Be fruitful and multiply."

items.en: To have sexual relations [only within] marriage
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כי יקח איש אשה ובא אליה" (דברים כב, יג) וראה דברים כד, א.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:1] states: "If a man takes a woman [as a wife]...."

items.en: For a groom to rejoice together with his wife for a year
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "נקי יהיה לביתו שנה אחת" (דברים כד, ה).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:5] states: "He shall be free for his home for one year."

items.en: To circumcise a son
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וביום השמיני ימול בשר ערלתו" (ויקרא יב, ג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 12:3] states: "On the eighth day, the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised."9The Rambam cites this verse, rather than a verse from Genesis, Chapter 17, which describes the circumcision of Abraham, because he prefers to cite a prooftext that was given after the giving of the Torah. Nevertheless, we also learn some particulars regarding this mitzvah from the passage from Genesis. (See also the Rambam's Commentary on the Mishnah, Chulin 7:6.)

items.en: To marry the widow of one's brother who died childless
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "יבמה יבוא עליה" (דברים כה,ה).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 25:5] states: "Her yavam shall come unto her."

items.en: To remove the yavam's shoe [if he does not marry his brother's widow]
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וחלצה נעלו מעל רגלו" (דברים כה,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 25:9] states: "And she shall remove his shoe from his foot."

items.en: For a rapist to marry the woman he raped
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ולו תהיה לאישה" (דברים כב,כט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:29] states: "She shall become his wife."

items.he: לישב מוציא שם רע עם אשתו כל ימיו
items.en: For a person who made defamatory remarks about his wife to remain married to her for his entire life
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ולו תהיה לאישה" (דברים כב,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:19] states: "She shall become his wife. He may not send her away for his entire life."

items.he: לדון במפתה בחמישים שקל עם שאר דינין
items.en: To carry out the judgment concerning a seducer, fining him fifty shekels and carrying out the other laws regarding this matter
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כי יפתה איש" (שמות כב,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:15] states: "If a person will seduce...."

items.en: To carry out the procedure [the Torah] prescribes for a yefat to'ar
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וראית, בשביה, אשת, יפת תואר" (דברים כא,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 21:11] states: "And if you see a beautiful woman among the captives...."

items.en: To divorce with a get
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וכתב לה ספר כריתות ונתן בידה" (דברים כד,א; דברים כד,ג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:1] states: "And he shall write a bill of divorce for her and place it in her hand."

items.en: To carry out the [procedure] prescribed for a sotah
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ועשה לה הכוהן, את כל התורה הזאת" (במדבר ה,ל).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 5:30] states: "And the priests will carry out all these laws for her."

items.en: To whip the wicked
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "והפילו השופט והכהו" (דברים כה,ב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 25:2] states: "The judge will cast him down and beat him."

items.en: To exile a person who accidentally kills a person
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וישב בה, עד מות הכוהן" (במדבר לה,כה).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 35:25] states: "And he shall dwell there until the High Priest dies...."

items.en: For a court to execute by decapitation
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "נקום, יינקם" (שמות כא,כ).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 21:20] states: "Revenge shall surely be taken."

items.en: For a court to execute by strangulation
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "מות יומת הנואף, והנואפת" (ויקרא כ,י).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 20:10] states: "The adulterer and the adulteress shall die."

items.en: For a court to execute by burning [the condemned] with fire
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "באש ישרפו אותו, ואתהן" (ויקרא כ,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 20:14] states: "They shall burn him and them with fire."

items.en: For a court to execute by stoning [the condemned] with stones
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וסקלתם אותם" (דברים כב,כד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:24] states: "And you shall stone them."

items.en: To hang [the corpses] of those liable for hanging
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "ותלית אותו, על עץ" (דברים כא,כב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 21:22] states: "And you shall hang them on a gallows."

items.en: To bury [the body of] an executed person on the day of his execution
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כי קבור תקברנו ביום ההוא" (דברים כא,כג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 21:22] states: "For you shall surely bury him on that day."

items.en: To carry out the laws concerning a Hebrew servant
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כי תקנה עבד עברי" (שמות כא,ב).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 21:2] states: "When you purchase a Hebrew servant...."

items.en: To marry a Hebrew maidservant
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "אשר לו יעדה" (שמות כא,ח), "ואם לבנו, ייעדנה" (שמות כא,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 21:8] states: "Who has designated her for himself... and she will be redeemed."

items.en: To redeem a Hebrew maidservant
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "והפדה" (שמות כא,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus, ibid.] states: "And she will be redeemed."

items.en: To have a Canaanite servant serve forever
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "לעולם, בהם תעבודו" (ויקרא כה,מו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:46] states: "You shall have them serve you forever."

items.en: For a person who injures [a colleague] to pay him damages
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וכי יריבון אנשים--והכה איש" (שמות כא,יח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 21:18] states: "If men will quarrel and one man will strike [his colleague]...."

items.en: To judge regarding the damages caused by an ox
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וכי ייגוף שור איש את שור ריעהו" (שמות כא,לה).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 21:35] states: "If an ox belonging to one person gores an ox belonging to a colleague...."

items.en: To judge regarding the damages caused by a pit
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כי יפתח איש בור" (שמות כא,לג).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 21:33] states: If a person will open a pit...."

items.en: To judge a thief, obligating him for payment or execution
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וכי יגנוב" (ראה שמות כא,לז), "אם במחתרת" (שמות כב,א), "וגונב איש ומכרו" (שמות כא,טז).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 21:37] states: "Should a theft be perpetrated," as [Exodus 22:1] states: "If when breaking in," and, as [Exodus 21:16] states: "If one kidnaps a person and sells him,…. "10The Rambam cites these different verses because each involves a different punishment. (See also Negative Mitzvot 243 and 244.)

items.en: To judge regarding the damages caused by grazing
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כי יבער איש, שדה או כרם" (שמות כב,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:4] states: "If a person will graze [his animals] in a field or vineyard...."

items.en: To judge regarding the damages caused by fire
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כי תצא אש ומצאה קוצים" (שמות כב,ה).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:5] states: "If fire will break out and catch in thorns...."

items.en: To render judgment [in questions] regarding an unpaid watchman
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כי ייתן איש אל ריעהו כסף או כלים" (שמות כב,ו).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:6] states: "If a person will give a colleague money or utensils [to watch]...."

items.en: To render judgment [in questions] regarding a paid watchman
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "כי ייתן איש אל ריעהו חמור או שור" (שמות כב,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:9] states: "Should a person give a donkey or an ox...."

items.en: To render judgment [in questions] regarding a borrower
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וכי ישאל איש מעם ריעהו" (שמות כב,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:13] states: "If a person will borrow from a colleague...."

items.en: To render judgment [in questions] regarding business transactions
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וכי תמכרו ממכר לעמיתך" (ויקרא כה,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:14] states: "If you sell merchandise to your colleague...."

items.en: To render judgment [in questions] regarding claims made by one person against another
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "על כל דבר פשע" (שמות כב,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:8] states: "For every matter of trespass, concerning an ox, concerning a donkey, or concerning a sheep...."

items.en: To save a person who is being pursued even if it is necessary to kill the pursuer
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "וקצותה, את כפה" (דברים כה,יב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 25:12] states: "And you shall cut off her hand...."

items.en: To render judgment [in questions] regarding inheritances
items.srcHe: שנאמר: "איש כי ימות, ובן אין לו" (במדבר כז,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 27:8] states: "If a person dies without having a son...."

items.he: שלא לעלות במחשבה שיש שם אלוה זולתי ה'
items.en: Not to consider the thought that there is another divinity aside from God
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יהיה לך אלוהים אחרים, על פניי" (שמות כ,ב; דברים ה,ו).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:3] states: "You shall have no other gods before Me."

items.he: שלא לעשות פסל, לא יעשה בידו ולא יעשו לו אחרים
items.en: Not to make an idol - not to make one oneself or have one made for oneself by others -
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תעשה לך פסל" (שמות כ,ג; דברים ה,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:4] states: "Do not make an idol for yourselves."

items.he: שלא לעשות עבודה זרה ואפילו לאחרים
items.en: Not to make false gods even for others
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ואלוהי מסכה, לא תעשו לכם" (ויקרא יט,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:4] states: "Do not make molten gods for yourselves."

items.he: שלא לעשות צורות לנואי, ואף על פי שאין עובדין אותן
items.en: Not to make images for decoration, even when one does not worship them
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תעשון, איתי" (שמות כ,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:20] states: "Do not make a representation of anything that is with Me."

items.he: שלא להשתחוות לעבודה זרה, ואף על פי שאין דרך עבודתה בהשתחוויה
items.en: Not to bow down to any false gods, even though they are not generally worshiped by bowing down before them
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תשתחווה להם" (שמות כ,ד; דברים ה,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:5] states: "Do not bow down to them."

items.he: שלא לעבוד עבודה זרה בדברים שדרכה להיעבד בהם
items.en: Not to worship false gods with the types of service with which it is customary to worship them
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תעבדם" (שמות כ,ד; שמות כג,כד; דברים ה,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:4] states: "Do not serve them."

items.en: Not to offer one's son to Molech
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ומזרעך לא תיתן, להעביר למולך" (ויקרא יח,כא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:21] states: "Do not give [any] of your children to offer to Molech."

items.en: Not to perform the deeds associated with an ov
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אל תפנו אל האובות" (ויקרא יט,לא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:31] states: "Do not turn to the ovot."

items.en: Not to perform the deeds associated with a yid'oni
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ואל היידעונים" (ויקרא יט,לא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:31] states: "Do not turn to... the yid'onim."

items.en: Not to take interest in the worship of false gods
items.srcHe: שנאמר (ויקרא יט, ד): "אל תפנו אל האלילים".
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:4] states: "Do not turn to false gods."

items.en: Not to erect a pillar [for purposes of worship]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תקים לך, מצבה" (דברים טז,כב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 16:22] states: "Do not erect a pillar for yourselves."

items.en: Not to make hewn stones [upon which to prostrate oneself]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ואבן משכית לא תיתנו בארצכם" (ויקרא כו,א).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 26:1] states: "You shall not place hewn stones..."

items.en: Not to plant a tree on the Temple [premises]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תיטע לך אשרה, כל עץ" (דברים טז,כא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 16:21] states: "Do not plant an asherah or any other tree...."

items.he: שלא לישבע בעבודה זרה לעובדיה, ולא משביעין אותן בה
items.en: Not to take an oath on a false god [as requested by] one of its worshipers, nor to have one of them take an oath on [their false god]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ושם אלוהים אחרים לא תזכירו, לא יישמע על פיך" (שמות כג,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:13] states: "And the name of other gods you shall not mention, nor should it be heard from your mouth."

items.he: שלא להדיח בני ישראל אחר עבודה זרה
items.en: Not to act as a missionary [madiach] to persuade the Jews to worship false gods]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יישמע על פיך" (שמות כג,יג); זו אזהרה למדיח.
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:13] states: "And the name of other gods... shall not be heard from your mouth." [Our Sages taught that] this is a prohibition against acting as a missionary for the worship of false gods.

items.he: שלא להסית אדם מישראל אחר עבודה זרה
items.en: Not to act as a missionary [mesit] to persuade an individual Jew to worship false gods
items.srcHe: שנאמר במסית "ולא יוסיפו לעשות" (דברים יג,יב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 13:12] states with regard to such missionaries: "And they shall not continue to do so."

items.en: Not to show affection for a mesit
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תאבה לו" (דברים יג,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 13:9] states: "Do not show appreciation for him."

items.en: Not to reduce one's hatred for a mesit
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תשמע אליו" (דברים יג,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 13:9] states: "Do not listen to him."

items.he: שלא להציל המסית אלא עומד על דמו
items.en: Not to [try to] save a mesit, but rather to see to it that he is executed
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תחוס עינך עליו" (דברים יג,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 13:9] states: "Do not have mercy upon him."

items.he: שלא ילמד המוסת זכות על המסית
items.en: For the person whom a mesit tried to convince not to advance any arguments on behalf of the mesit
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תחמול" (דברים יג,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 13:9] states: "Do not have pity... [upon him]."

items.he: שלא ישתוק המוסת מללמד חובה על המסית, אם ידע לו חובה
items.en: For the person whom a mesit tried to convince not to withhold any evidence he is aware of that would incriminate the mesit
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תכסה עליו" (דברים יג,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 13:9] states: "And do not try to cover up for him."

items.en: Not to benefit from ornaments that have adorned false gods
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תחמוד כסף וזהב עליהם" (דברים ז,כה).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 7:25] states: "Do not covet the gold or silver which is upon them...."

items.he: שלא לבנות עיר הנידחת לכמות שהייתה
items.en: Not to rebuild an apostate city to its former stature
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תיבנה עוד" (דברים יג,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 13:17] states: "It shall never be rebuilt."

items.en: Not to benefit from the property of an apostate city
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא ידבק בידך מאומה, מן החרם" (דברים יג,יח).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 13:18] states: "Let nothing that has been condemned cling to your hand."

items.he: שלא ליהנות בעבודה זרה, ובכל משמשיה ובתקרובת שלה וביין שנתנסך לה
items.en: Not to benefit from false gods, from any of their accessories, anything offered to them, or any wine brought as a libation for them
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תביא תועבה אל ביתך" (דברים ז,כו).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 7:26] states: "Do not bring an abomination into your house."

items.en: Not to prophesy in the name of false gods
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ואשר ידבר, בשם אלוהים אחרים" (דברים יח,כ).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 18:20] states: "[The prophet]... who speaks in the name of other gods [shall die]."

items.en: Not to relate false prophecies
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אשר יזיד לדבר דבר בשמי, את אשר לא ציוויתיו" (דברים יח,כ).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 18:20] states: "When a prophet presumptuously makes a declaration in My name which I have not commanded him...."

items.he: שלא לשמוע למתנבא בשם עבודה זרה
items.en: Not to listen to someone who prophesies in the name of false gods
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תשמע, אל דברי הנביא" (דברים יג,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 13:4] states: "Do not listen to the words of that prophet."

items.he: שלא נימנע מהריגת נביא השקר ולא נירא ממנו
items.en: Not to refrain from executing a false prophet, nor to fear him
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תגור ממנו" (דברים יח,כב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 18:22] states: "Do not fear him."

items.he: שלא ללכת בחוקות עובדי עבודה זרה ולא במנהגותם
items.en: Not to follow the laws or customs of the worshipers of false gods
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תלכו בחוקות הגוי" (ויקרא כ,כג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 20:23] states: "Do not follow the practices of the nation [that I am driving out before you]...."

items.en: Not to practice black magic
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יימצא בך . . . קוסם קסמים" (דברים יח,י).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 18:10] states: "There shall not be found among you... a magician."

items.en: Not to practice divination
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תעוננו" (ויקרא יט,כו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:26] states: "Do not practice divination."

items.en: Not to act as a soothsayer
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תנחשו" (ויקרא יט,כו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] states: "Do not act as a soothsayer."

items.en: Not to practice sorcery
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יימצא בך . . . ומכשף" (דברים יח,י).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 18:10] states: "There shall not be found among you... a sorcerer."

items.en: Not to cast spells
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וחובר, חבר" (דברים יח,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 18:11] states: "[There shall not be found among you...] one who casts spells."

items.en: Not to consult an ov
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ושואל אוב" (דברים יח,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] states: "[There shall not be found among you...] one who consults an ov."

items.en: Not to consult a yid'oni
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ושואל אוב ויידעוני" (דברים יח,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] states: "[There shall not be found among you...] one who consults an ov or a yid'oni."

items.en: Not to seek information from the dead in dreams
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ודורש אל המתים" (דברים יח,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] states: "[There shall not be found among you...] one who attempts to communicate with the dead."

items.en: For a woman not to wear articles appropriate for men
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יהיה כלי גבר על אישה" (דברים כב,ה).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:5] states: "A woman should not wear a man's clothing."

items.en: For a man not to wear articles appropriate for women
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא ילבש גבר שמלת אישה" (דברים כב,ה), מפני שזה היה מנהג עובדי עבודה זרה וכן מפורש בספרי עבודתה.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:5] states: "A man should not wear a woman's clothing." [This prohibition was instituted] because this is an idolatrous custom. Explicit statements to this effect are found in the texts describing their worship.

items.he: שלא לכתוב בגוף כעובדי עבודה זרה
items.en: Not to tattoo our bodies like the worshipers of false gods
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וכתובת קעקע, לא תיתנו בכם" (ויקרא יט,כח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:28] states: "Do not tattoo your flesh."

items.he: שלא ללבוש שעטנז כמו שלובשין כומרי עבודה זרה
items.en: Not to wear sha'atnez, as do the priests of false gods
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תלבש שעטנז" (דברים כב,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:11] states: "Do not wear sha'atnez."

items.he: שלא להקיף פיאת ראש ככומרי עבודה זרה
items.en: Not to shave the temples of our heads, as do the worshipers of false gods
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תקיפו, פאת ראשכם" (ראה ויקרא יט,כז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:27] states: "Do not shave your temples."

items.he: שלא להשחית כל הזקן כעובדי עבודה זרה
items.en: Not to shave off our beards entirely, as do the priests of false gods
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תשחית, את פאת זקנך" (ויקרא יט,כז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:27] states: "Do not shave the corners of your beard."

items.en: Not to make cuts in our flesh, as the worshipers of false gods do
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תתגודדו" (דברים יד,א); וגדידה ושריטה אחת היא.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 14:1] states: "Do not cut yourselves." Gedidah is another term for cutting.

items.en: Not to ever dwell in the land of Egypt
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תוסיפון לשוב בדרך הזה, עוד" (דברים יז,טז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 17:16] states: "Do not ever return on this path again."

items.he: שלא לתור אחר מחשבות הלב וראיית העיניים
items.en: Not to stray after the thoughts of one's heart or the sights one's eyes behold
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תתורו . . ." (במדבר טו,לט).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 15:39] states: "Do not stray after your heart and eyes."

items.en: Not to establish a covenant with the seven [Canaanite] nations
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תכרות להם ברית" (דברים ז,ב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 7:2] states: "Do not establish a covenant with them."

items.en: Not to allow a single member of the seven [Canaanite] nations to live
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תחייה, כל נשמה" (דברים כ,טז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 20:16] states: "Do not allow a soul to live."

items.he: שלא לחון על עובדי עבודה זרה
items.en: Not to show favor to the worshipers of false gods
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תחונם" (דברים ז,ב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 7:2] states: "Do not show them favor."

items.he: שלא להושיב עובדי עבודה זרה בארצנו
items.en: Not to allow the worshipers of false gods to settle in our land
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יישבו בארצך" (שמות כג,לג).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:33] states: "They shall not settle in your land."

items.en: Not to marry gentiles
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תתחתן, בם" (דברים ז,ג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 7:3] states: "Do not marry among them."

items.he: שלא יישא עמוני ומואבי בת ישראל לעולם
items.en: For a Jewish woman never to marry an Ammonite or Moabite [even after conversion]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יבוא עמוני ומואבי, בקהל ה'" (דברים כג,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:4] states: "An Ammonite or a Moabite shall never enter the congregation of God."

items.he: שלא להרחיק זרע עשיו מן הקהל אלא עד שלושה דורות
items.en: Not to prevent the third generation of [converts from] the descendants of Esau from marrying among [the Jewish people]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תתעב אדומי" (דברים כג,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:8] states: "Do not [utterly] despise an Edomite."

items.he: שלא להרחיק מצרי מלבוא בקהל אלא עד שלושה דורות
items.en: Not to prevent the third generation of Egyptian [converts] from marrying among [the Jewish people]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תתעב מצרי" (דברים כג,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:8] states: "Do not [utterly] despise an Egyptian."

items.he: שלא לקרוא שלום לעמון ומואב בתחילה בשעת מלחמה כשאר גויים
items.en: Not to make an offer of peace to Ammon and Moav at the outbreak of war, as is done for other nations
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תדרוש שלומם, וטובתם" (דברים כג,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:7] states: "Do not seek their peace and welfare...."

items.he: שלא להשחית אילני מאכל, וכן כל שיש בו השחתה אסור
items.en: Not to destroy fruit trees nor to destroy anything else of value
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תשחית את עצה" (דברים כ,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 20:19] states: "Do not destroy its trees."

items.he: שלא ייראו אנשי המלחמה ולא יפחדו מאויביהם בשעת מלחמה
items.en: For soldiers not to fear or become frightened of the enemy during war
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תערוץ, מפניהם" (דברים ז,כא), "לא, תיראום" (דברים ג,כב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 7:21] states: "Do not panic before them," and [Deuteronomy 3:22] states: "Do not fear them."

items.he: שלא יסור מליבנו מעשה עמלק הרע שעשה לנו
items.en: Not to forget the wicked deeds which Amalek perpetrated against us
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא, תשכח" (דברים כה,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 25:19] states: "Do not forget."

items.en: The prohibition against blessing [i.e., cursing] God's name
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אלוהים, לא תקלל" (שמות כב,כז), ונאמר בעונש "ונוקב שם ה' מות יומת" (ויקרא כד,טז). .וזה הכלל: .כל שענש עליו הכתוב כרת או מיתת בית דין, הרי זו מצות לא תעשה--חוץ ממילה ופסח, שהן בכרת והן מצוות עשה.
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:27] states: "Do not curse God." [Leviticus 24:16] mentions the punishment: "One who curses the name of God shall surely die." This is a general principle: A negative commandment is involved whenever the Torah mentions the punishments of karet or execution - with the exception of circumcision and the Paschal sacrifice which are positive commandments punishable by karet.

items.en: Not to violate an oath
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְלֹא תִשָּׁבְעוּ בִשְׁמִי לַשָּׁקֶר" (ויקרא יט, יב)
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:12] states: "Do not swear falsely in My name."

items.en: Not to take an oath in vain
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תִשָּׂא אֶת שֵׁם ה' אֱלֹהֶיךָ לַשָּׁוְא" (שמות כ, ו; דברים ה, י).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:7] states: "Do not take the name of God, your Lord, in vain."

items.he: שלא לחלל את שם הקדוש ברוך הוא
items.en: Not to profane the name of the Holy One, blessed be He
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְלֹא תְחַלְּלוּ אֶת שֵׁם קָדְשִׁי" (ויקרא כב, לב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:32] states: "Do not profane My holy name."

items.en: Not to test the promises of God
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תְנַסּוּ אֶת ה' אֱלֹהֵיכֶם" (דברים ו, טז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 6:16] states: "Do not test God, your Lord."

items.he: שלא לאבד בית המקדש, או בתי כנסייות, או בתי מדרשות; וכן אין מוחקין את השמות המוקדשין, ואין מאבדין כתבי הקודש
items.en: Not to destroy the Temple, synagogues, or houses of study; and similarly, not to erase any of [God’s] sacred names, nor to destroy any sacred texts
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אַבֵּד תְּאַבְּדוּן" (דברים יב, ב), "לֹא תַעֲשׂוּן כֵּן לַה' אֱלֹהֵיכֶם" (שם, ד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 12:3-4] states: "You shall surely destroy them.
