Do not do this to God, your Lord."1Note the comments of the Kessef Mishneh, who differentiates between sacred texts whose destruction Hilchot Yesodei HaTorah 6:8 considers a rabbinic offense, and the destruction of the other objects which are forbidden by the Torah itself.

items.en: Not to leave a corpse that was hung on the gallows
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תָלִין נִבְלָתוֹ עַל הָעֵץ" (דברים כא, כג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 21:23] states: "Do not leave his body on the gallows."

items.en: Not to interrupt the watch held around the Temple
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתִּי" (ויקרא יח, ל).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:30] states: "And you shall keep My watch."2Though this prooftext is quoted in the printed editions of the Mishneh Torah, it appears to be an error, because the passage it introduces deals with sexual offenses. In Sefer HaMitzvot, the Rambam quotes as a prooftext Numbers 18:5, "And you shall keep the watch over the holy articles."

items.he: שלא יכנס כהן להיכל בכל עת
items.en: For a priest not to enter the Temple building at all times
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְאַל יָבֹא בְּכָל עֵת אֶל הַקֹדֶשׁ" (ויקרא טז, ב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 16:2] states: "And he shall not enter the sanctuary at all times."

items.he: שלא יכנס בעל מום מן המזבח ולפנים
items.en: For a priest with a disqualifying physical deformity not to proceed beyond [the beginning of] the altar
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אַךְ אֶל הַפָּרֹכֶת לֹא יָבֹא" (ויקרא כא, כג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:23] states: "However, to the parochet3The parochet was the curtain separating the Temple sanctuary from the Holy of Holies. he shall not approach."

items.en: For a priest with a disqualifying physical deformity not to serve [in the Temple]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ מוּם" (ויקרא כא, יז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:17] states: "[Anyone...] who has a blemish [may not approach to present]...."

items.en: For a priest with a disqualifying physical deformity of a temporary nature not to serve [in the Temple]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "כָּל אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם לֹא יִקְרַב" (ויקרא כא, יח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:18] states: "Anyone who has a blemish may not approach [to offer a sacrifice].

items.he: שלא יתעסקו הלויים בעבודת הכהנים ולא הכהנים בעבודת הלויים
items.en: For the Levites not to perform the services of the priests, and for the priests not to perform the services of the Levites
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אֶל כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יִקְרְבוּ גַם הֵם גַּם אַתֶּם" (במדבר יח, ג).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 18:3] states with regard to the Levites: "Neither to the sacred vessels nor to the altar shall they approach, so that they do not die, neither they nor you."

items.he: שלא יכנס למקדש ולא יורה בתורה שתוי יין
items.en: For a person who is intoxicated not to enter the Temple nor to render a halachic decision
items.srcHe: שנאמר "יַיִן וְשֵׁכָר אַל תֵּשְׁתְּ בְּבוֹאֲכֶם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד" (ויקרא י, ט) ונאמר "וּלְהוֹרוֹת אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל" (ויקרא י, יא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 10:9] states: "Do not drink wine or strong drink when you enter the Tent of Testimony," and [ibid., 10:11] states: "or when you render a decision for the children of Israel."

items.en: For a non-priest not to serve in the Temple
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְזָר לֹא יִקְרַב אֲלֵיכֶם" (במדבר יח, ד).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 18:4] states: "An unauthorized person shall not approach them."

items.en: For a priest who is ritually impure not to serve [in the Temple]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְיִנָּזְרוּ מִקָּדְשֵׁי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל" (ויקרא כב, ב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:2] states: "And they shall separate themselves from the sacred offerings of the children of Israel."

items.he: שלא יעבוד כהן טבול יום עד שיעריב שמשו
items.en: For a priest who has immersed himself in a mikveh in order to purify himself from ritual impurity not to serve [in the Temple] until the conclusion, of that day
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ" (ויקרא כא, ו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:6] states: "And they shall not profane...."

items.en: For a priest who is ritually impure not to enter the Temple courtyard
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְלֹא יְטַמְּאוּ אֶת מַחֲנֵיהֶם" (במדבר ה, ג); זה מחנה שכינה.
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 5:3] states: "And they shall not make your camp impure." This refers to the camp of the Divine Presence.

items.he: שלא יכנס טמא למחנה לויה שכנגדו לדורות הר הבית
items.en: For a person who is impure not to enter the camp of the Levites, the parallel for all time being the Temple Mount
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא יָבֹא אֶל תּוֹךְ הַמַּחֲנֶה" (דברים כג, יא); זה מחנה לויה.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:11] states: "Do not enter the camp." This refers to the camp of the Levites.

items.en: Not to build the altar with hewn stones
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תִבְנֶה אֶתְהֶן גָּזִית" (שמות כ, כא).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:22] states: "Do not make them hewn."

items.en: Not to ascend to the altar using steps
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְלֹא תַעֲלֶה בְּמַעֲלוֹת עַל מִזְבְּחִי" (שמות כ, כב).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:23] states: "Do not ascend My altar with steps."

items.en: Not to extinguish the fire of the altar
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אש, תמיד תוקד על המזבח--לא תכבה" (ויקרא ו,ו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 6:6] states: "Burn a continuous fire on the altar. Do not extinguish it."

items.en: Not to offer any [undesired] incense offering or any sacrifices on the golden altar
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תעלו עליו קטורת זרה" (שמות ל,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 30:9] states: "Do not offer any unauthorized incense upon it."

items.en: Not to duplicate the composition of the anointing oil
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ובמתכונתו, לא תעשו" (שמות ל,לב).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 30:32] states: "And do not duplicate its formula."

items.en: Not to anoint an unauthorized person with the anointing oil
items.srcHe: שנאמר "על בשר אדם, לא ייסך" (שמות ל,לב).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 30:32] states: "Do not anoint the flesh of a person with it."

items.en: Not to duplicate the composition of the incense offering
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ובמתכונתה, לא תעשו" (ראה שמות ל,לז).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 30:37] states: "Do not duplicate its formula."

items.en: Not to remove the staves of the ark
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא יָסֻרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ" (שמות כה, טו).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 25:16] states: "They shall not be removed from it."

items.en: For the [High Priest's] breastplate not to come loose from the ephod
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא ייזח החושן, מעל האיפוד" (שמות כח,כח; שמות לט,כא).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 28:28] states: "The breastplate shall not come loose from the ephod."

items.en: For the [High Priest's] cloak not to tear
items.srcHe: שנאמר "כפי תחרא יהיה לו--לא ייקרע" (שמות כח,לב).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 28:32] states: "It shall have a woven border around it. It shall not tear."

items.en: Not to offer sacred offerings outside [the Temple]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "הישמר לך, פן תעלה עולותיך" (דברים יב,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 12:13] states: "Be careful, lest you offer your burnt offerings...."

items.en: Not to slaughter sacred offerings outside [the Temple]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "איש . . . אשר ישחט שור או כשב" (ויקרא יז,ג) "ואל פתח אוהל מועד, לא הביאו . . . ונכרת" (ויקרא יז,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 17:3-4] states: "A person who slaughters an ox or a sheep without bringing it to the Tent of Testimony. He shall be punished by karet."

items.en: Not to consecrate animals with disqualifying physical blemishes [as sacrifices to be offered on] the altar
items.srcHe: שנאמר "כול אשר בו מום, לא תקריבו" (ויקרא כב,כ); זה הוא איסור הקדשו.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:20] states: "Any [animal] which has a blemish shall not be sacrificed." This prohibition involves [the animal's] consecration.

items.he: שלא לשחוט בעלי מומין לשם קרבן
items.en: Not to slaughter animals with disqualifying physical blemishes as sacrifices
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תקריבו אלה, לה'" (ויקרא כב,כב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:22] states: "Do not sacrifice these to God."

items.he: שלא לזרוק דם בעלי מומין לגבי המזבח
items.en: Not to sprinkle the blood of animals with disqualifying physical blemishes on the altar
items.srcHe: שנאמר בבעלי מומין "לא תקריבו לה'" (ויקרא כב,כד); וזה הוא איסור זריקת דמו.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:24] states: "Do not sacrifice to God...." This prohibition involves sprinkling [the animal's] blood."

items.en: Not to burn the sacrificial portions of animals with disqualifying physical blemishes [as sacrifices on the altar]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ואישה, לא תיתנו מהם" (ויקרא כב,כב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:22] states: "Do not make a fire offering of them."

items.en: Not to offer animals with disqualifying physical blemishes of a temporary nature as sacrifices
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תזבח לה' אלוהיך שור ושה, אשר יהיה בו מום" (דברים יז,א); זה הוא מום עובר.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 17:1] states: "Do not sacrifice to God, your Lord, an ox or a sheep that has a blemish." This refers to a blemish of a temporary nature.

items.he: שלא להקריב בעל מום מיד הגויים
items.en: Not to offer an animal with a disqualifying physical blemish as a sacrifice when it was brought by gentiles
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ומיד בן נכר, לא תקריבו" (ויקרא כב,כה).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:25] states: "Do not offer sacrifices [from these animals] when they are given by gentiles."

items.en: Not to inflict a disqualifying physical blemish upon a consecrated animal
items.srcHe: שנאמר "מום לא יהיה בו" (ויקרא כב,כא); כלומר, לא תיתן בו מום.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:21] states: "It shall not have a blemish." This can be interpreted to mean: Do not inflict a blemish upon it.

items.en: Not to burn as an offering anything which is sweetened or leavened
items.srcHe: שנאמר (ויקרא ב, יא): "כִּי כָל שְׂאוֹר וְכָל דְבַשׁ, לֹא תַקְטִירוּ".
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 2:11] states: "You may not burn anything leavened or sweet [as a fire offering]."

items.en: Not to offer a sacrifice which is unsalted
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תשבית מלח ברית אלוהיך" (ויקרא ב,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 2:13] states: "Do not omit the salt of God's covenant."

items.en: Not to offer as a sacrifice an animal received by a prostitute as her fee, or an animal received in exchange for a dog
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תביא אתנן זונה ומחיר כלב" (דברים כג,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:19] states: "Do not bring a prostitute's fee or the price of a dog...."

items.en: Not to slaughter an animal and its offspring on the same day
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אותו ואת בנו, לא תשחטו ביום אחד" (ויקרא כב,כח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:28] states: "Do not slaughter it and its offspring on the same day."

items.he: שלא ליתן שמן זית במנחת חוטא
items.en: Not to place olive oil on the meal offering brought by a sinner
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא ישים עליה שמן" (ויקרא ה,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 5:11] states: "Do not place oil upon it."

items.en: Not to place frankincense on such a sacrifice
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא ייתן עליה לבונה" (ויקרא ה,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] continues: "...and do not place frankincense upon it."

items.en: Not to place oil on the meal offering brought by a sotah
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא ייצוק עליו שמן" (במדבר ה,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 5:15] states: "Do not pour oil upon it."

items.en: Not to place frankincense on such a sacrifice
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא ייתן עליו לבונה" (במדבר ה,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers, ibid.] continues: "...and do not place frankincense upon it."

items.en: Not to substitute [another animal]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יחליפנו, ולא ימיר אותו" (ויקרא כז,י).
items.srcEn: for [one selected as] a sacred offering, as [Leviticus 27:10] states: "Do not exchange it or substitute another for it."

items.he: שלא לשנות את הקודשים מקרבן לקרבן
items.en: Not to change the designation of a consecrated animal from one sacrifice to another
items.srcHe: שנאמר בבכור "לא יקדיש איש, אותו" (ויקרא כז,כו); כלומר, לא יקדישנו לקרבן אחר.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 27:26] states regarding a firstling animal: "A person should not consecrate it" - i.e., he should not consecrate it as another sacrifice.

items.en: Not to redeem a firstling kosher animal
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אך בכור שור . . . לא תפדה" (במדבר יח,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 18:17] states: "Nevertheless, a firstling ox... do not redeem."

items.en: Not to sell the tithe of cattle
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא ייגאל" (ויקרא כז,לג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 27:33] states: "It shall not be redeemed."

items.en: Not to sell a field that has been dedicated
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יימכר" (ויקרא כז,כח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 27:28] states: "It shall not be sold."

items.en: Not to redeem a field that has been dedicated
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא ייגאל" (ויקרא כז,כח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] states: "It shall not be redeemed."

items.en: Not to sever the head of a bird [brought as] a sin offering
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ומלק את ראשו ממול עורפו [ולא יבדיל]" (ויקרא ה,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 5:8] states: "He shall pinch off its head...[without separating it]."

items.en: Not to work with consecrated animals
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תעבוד בבכור שורך" (דברים טו,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 15:19] states: "Do not work with your firstling ox."

items.en: Not to shear consecrated animals
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תגוז בכור צאנך" (דברים טו,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 15:19] states: "Do not shear your firstling sheep."

items.en: Not to slaughter the Paschal sacrifice while one possesses chametz
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תשחט על חמץ, דם זבחי" (שמות לד,כה).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:18] states: "Do not sacrifice the blood of My offering in the presence of chametz."

items.he: שלא להניח אימורי הפסח עד שיפסלו בלינה
items.en: Not to allow the sacrificial portions of the Paschal sacrifice to become disqualified by remaining overnight
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא ילין חלב חגי, עד בוקר" (שמות כג,יח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:18] states: "Do not allow the fat of My festive offering to remain until the morning."

items.en: Not to allow the meat of the Paschal sacrifice to remain [overnight]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תותירו ממנו, עד בוקר" (שמות יב,י).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:10] states: "Do not leave over any of it until the morning."

items.he: שלא להותיר מחגיגת ארבעה עשר ליום השלישי
items.en: Not to allow the meat of the Chaggigah sacrifice to remain until the third day
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא ילין מן הבשר" (דברים טז,ד); מפי השמועה למדו שבבשר חגיגת ארבעה עשר הכתוב מדבר, וזה שנאמר "לבוקר" (שם) לבוקרו של יום שני של פסח, שהוא שלישי לשחיטה.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 16:4] states: "Do not leave over any of the meat...." According to the oral tradition, we have learned that the verse refers to the Chaggigah sacrifice offered on the fourteenth of Nisan. The phrase "until the morning" [in that verse] refers to the morning of the second day of Pesach, the third day after [the sacrifice] was offered.

items.he: שלא להותיר מבשר פסח שני עד בוקר
items.en: Not to allow the meat of the second Paschal sacrifice to remain until the morning
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא ישאירו ממנו עד בוקר" (ראה במדבר ט,יב).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 9:12] states: "Do not leave over any of it until the morning."

items.he: שלא להותיר מבשר התודה עד בוקר
items.en: Not to allow the meat of the thanksgiving offering to remain until the morning
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תותירו ממנו, עד בוקר" (ראה ויקרא כב,ל); והוא הדין לשאר הקודשים, שאין מניחין אותן לאחר זמן אכילתן.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:30] states: "Do not leave over any of it until the morning." The same law applies to all other sacrifices. They should not be left over beyond the time allotted for their consumption.

items.en: Not to break any of the bones of the Paschal sacrifice
items.srcHe: שנאמר (שמות יב, מו): "ועצם לא תשברו בו".
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:46] states: "Neither shall you break a bone of it."

items.en: Not to break any of the bones of the Second Paschal sacrifice
items.srcHe: שנאמר (שמות יב, מו): "ועצם לא תשברו בו".
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 9:12] states: "Neither shall you break a bone of it."

items.he: שלא להוציא מבשר הפסח מן החבורה
items.en: Not to remove the meat of the Paschal sacrifice from the company [in which it is being eaten]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תוציא מן הבית" (שמות יב,מו).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:46] states: "Do not remove [any of the meat] from the house...."

items.en: Not to allow any of the remaining portions of the meal offerings to leaven
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תיאפה חמץ, חלקם" (ויקרא ו,י).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 6:10] states: "It shall not be baked as leaven. Their portion...."

items.he: שלא לאכול בשר הפסח נא ומבושל
items.en: Not to eat the meat of the Paschal sacrifice raw or boiled in water
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אל תאכלו ממנו נא, ובשל" (שמות יב,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:9] states: "Do not eat from it raw or boiled in water."

items.he: שלא להאכיל בשר הפסח לגר תושב
items.en: Not to feed the meat of the Paschal sacrifice to a resident alien
items.srcHe: שנאמר "תושב ושכיר, לא יאכל בו" (שמות יב,מה).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:45] states: "No temporary resident or hired worker may eat from it."

items.en: Not to feed the meat of the Paschal sacrifice to an uncircumcised male
items.srcHe: שנאמר "כל ערל, לא יאכל בו" (שמות יב,מח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:48] states: "No uncircumcised person may eat of it."

items.he: שלא להאכיל בשר הפסח לישראל שנשתמד
items.en: Not to feed the meat of the Paschal sacrifice to an apostate Jew
items.srcHe: שנאמר "כל בן נכר, לא יאכל בו" (שמות יב,מג); כלומר, ישראל שנלווה לבני נכר ועבד עבודה זרה כמותם לא יאכל בו.
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:43] states: "No outsider may eat from it." This refers to a Jew who has become assimilated among the gentiles and serves false gods, as they do. He must not partake [of the Paschal sacrifice].

items.en: For a person who became ritually impure not to partake of consecrated foods
items.srcHe: שנאמר "והנפש אשר תאכל בשר, מזבח השלמים אשר לה', וטומאתו, עליו" (ויקרא ז,כ).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 7:20] states: "And a soul who partakes of the meat of the peace sacrifice while he is impure...."

items.en: Not to partake of consecrated foods that have contracted ritual impurity
items.srcHe: שנאמר "והבשר אשר ייגע בכל טמא, לא ייאכל" (ויקרא ז,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 7:19] states: "Meat that has touched any impurity shall not be eaten."

items.en: Not to eat sacrificial meat that has remained past the limits allotted for its consumption
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ואוכליו עוונו יישא . . . ונכרתה הנפש ההיא, מעמיה" (ויקרא יט,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:8] states: "One who eats it shall bear his guilt,... his soul will be punished by karet."

items.en: Not to eat piggul
items.srcHe: שנאמר "המקריב אותו לא ייחשב לו, פיגול יהיה; והנפש האוכלת ממנו, עוונה תישא" (ויקרא ז,יח); והוא בכרת.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 7:18] states: "It will not be accepted for him. Instead, it will be considered as piggul. Any person who eats it will bear his guilt." This sin is punishable by karet.

items.en: For an unauthorized person not to partake of the terumot,4The plural terumot includes bikkurim (the first fruits), challah (the dough offering), and terumat ma'aser (the tenth of the tithe separated by the Levites), as well as the terumah gedolah
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וכל זר, לא יאכל קודש" (ויקרא כב,י).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:10] states: "No unauthorized person shall eat it."

items.he: שלא יאכל אפילו תושב כוהן ושכירו תרומה
items.en: For not even a tenant or a hired worker employed by a priest to partake of terumah
items.srcHe: שנאמר "תושב כוהן ושכיר, לא יאכל קודש" (ויקרא כב,י).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:10] states: "A tenant of a priest or [his] hired worker shall not eat the holy [food]."

items.he: שלא יאכל ערל תרומה, והוא הדין לשאר קודשים. .ודבר זה לימדו הכתוב מן הפסח בגזירה שווה, ואינו בפירוש מן התורה; ומפי השמועה למדו שאיסור ערל בקודשים מגופי תורה, ואינו מדברי סופרים
items.en: For an uncircumcised person not to partake of terumah or other consecrated foods. This concept was derived from a gezerah shavah and is not explicitly mentioned in the Torah. [Nevertheless,] based on the oral tradition, the prohibition against an uncircumcised person partaking of consecrated foods is considered as a [prohibition of] the Torah itself and not a decree of the Sages.5A gezerah shavah is one of the thirteen principles of Biblical exegesis in which an association is drawn between two verses based on a common word.In Sefer HaMitzvot (General Principle 2), the Rambam states that all of the 613 mitzvot are explicitly mentioned in the Torah and are not dependent on the exegesis of a verse according to the oral tradition. Therefore, he finds it necessary to explain that there is a specific oral tradition that this mitzvah is an exception to that rule
For a priest who is impure not to partake of terumah
items.srcHe: שנאמר "איש מזרעך . . . בקודשים לא יאכל" (ראה ויקרא כא,יז; ויקרא כב,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:4] states: "Any of your descendants... shall not eat from the consecrated foods."6Though this prooftext is quoted in the printed editions of the Mishneh Torah, it represents a misquotation of the verse, borrowing a phrase from Leviticus 21:17 and inserting it into Leviticus 22:4.

items.he: שלא תאכל חללה קודש, לא תרומות ולא חזה ושוק
items.en: For a chalalah not to partake of consecrated foods, neither terumah, nor the breast and the shankbone [given to the priest]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ובת כוהן--כי תהיה, לאיש זר" (ויקרא כב,יב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:12] states: "When a priest's daughter marries an unauthorized person, she shall not eat [from the sacred, elevated gifts]."

items.en: For a meal offering brought by a priest not to be eaten
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וכל מנחת כוהן כליל תהיה, לא תיאכל" (ויקרא ו,טז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 6:16] states: "Any meal offering brought by a priest shall be consumed entirely [by fire]; it shall not be eaten."

items.he: שלא לאכול בשר חטאות הנעשות בפנים
items.en: Not to partake of the meat of the sin offerings [whose blood is sprinkled] within [the Temple sanctuary]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וכל חטאת אשר יובא מדמה" (ויקרא ו,כג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 6:23] states: "Any sin offering whose blood has been brought...."

items.he: שלא לאכול פסולי המוקדשין שהוטל בהם מום בכוונה
items.en: Not to partake of consecrated animals that were disqualified [for use as sacrifices because] a blemish was intentionally inflicted upon them
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תאכל, כל תועבה" (דברים יד,ג); מפי השמועה למדנו שבפסולי המוקדשין שהוטל בהם מום הכתוב מדבר.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 14:3] states: "Do not eat of any abomination." According to the oral tradition, we have learned that the verse refers to consecrated animals that were disqualified for use because of a blemish inflicted upon them.

items.he: שלא לאכול מעשר שני של דגן חוץ לירושלים
items.en: Not to eat grain [separated as] the second tithe outside of Jerusalem
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תוכל לאכול בשעריך, מעשר דגנך" (דברים יב,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 12:17] states: "You may not eat within your gates the tithe from your grain."

items.he: שלא לאכול מעשר שני של תירוש חוץ לירושלים
items.en: Not to consume wine [separated as] the second tithe outside of Jerusalem
items.srcHe: שנאמר "תירושך" (דברים יב,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] continues: "...your wine...."

items.he: שלא לאכול מעשר שני של יצהר חוץ לירושלים
items.en: Not to consume oil [separated as] the second tithe outside of Jerusalem
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ויצהרך" (דברים יב,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] continues: "...and your oil...."

items.he: שלא לאכול בכור תמים חוץ לירושלים
items.en: Not to eat an unblemished firstling animal outside of Jerusalem
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תוכל . . . ובכורות" (דברים יב,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] states: "You may not eat [within your gates]... and the firstlings [of your cattle and flocks]...."

items.he: שלא יאכלו הכוהנים חטאת ואשם חוץ לעזרה
items.en: For the priests not to eat a sin offering or a guilt offering outside the Temple courtyard
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תוכל . . . בקרך, וצאנך" (דברים יב,יז); מפי השמועה למדו שלא בא הכתוב אלא לאסור בשר חטאות ואשמות חוץ לעזרה, לפי שכל דבר שייאכל חוץ למקום אכילתו "לא תוכל לאכול בשעריך" (שם) אקרא בו.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] continues: "...your cattle and your flocks." According to the oral tradition, the purpose of this phrase is only to forbid the consumption of the sin offerings and the guilt offerings outside the Temple courtyard. Anything that is eaten outside the place intended for it is covered by the [prohibition]: "You may not eat within your gates...."

items.en: Not to eat the meat of a burnt offering
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תוכל . . . נדריך אשר תידור" (דברים יב,יז); כלומר, לא תוכל לאכול נדריך אשר תידור. .וזו היא אזהרה של כל מועל, שלא ייהנה מן הקודשים האסורים ליהנות מהם; ואם נהנה, מעל.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] states: "You may not [eat]...[the sacrifices] you have vowed [to bring]...," meaning to say: You may not eat [the sacrifices] you have vowed to give. This is a warning against a person's benefiting from the [unauthorized use] of consecrated articles which he is forbidden to use. If he derives such benefit, he transgresses.

items.he: שלא לאכול בשר קודשים קלים קודם זריקת דמים
items.en: Not to eat the meat of sacrifices of a lesser order of holiness before the sprinkling of their blood
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תוכל . . . ונדבותיך" (דברים יב,יז); כלומר, לא תוכל לאכול נדבותיך עד שייזרק דמם.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] states: "You may not [eat]... the [animals] you have pledged [to bring as sacrifices]..." - i.e., you are not allowed to eat from the sacrifices you have pledged until their blood has been sprinkled.

items.he: שלא יאכל זר בשר קודשי קודשים
items.en: For an unauthorized person not to eat the meat of the sacrifices of the highest order of sanctity
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וזר לא יאכל, כי קודש הם" (שמות כט,לג).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 29:33] states: "An unauthorized person shall not partake of them, for they are holy."

items.he: שלא יאכל כוהן ביכורים קודם הנחה בעזרה
items.en: For a priest not to partake of the first fruits [Bikkurim] before they are placed down in the Temple courtyard
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תוכל . . . ותרומת ידך" (דברים יב,יז); אלו הביכורים.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] states: "You may not [eat]... the elevated gifts [delivered by] hand." The [latter phrase] refers to the first fruits.

items.he: שלא לאכול מעשר שני בטומאה ואפילו בירושלים עד שייפדה
items.en: Not to eat the second tithe which has become impure, even within Jerusalem, until it has been redeemed
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא ביערתי ממנו בטמא" (דברים כו,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 26:14] states: "I have not consumed it while it is impure."

items.en: Not to eat the second tithe while in mourning
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא אכלתי באוני ממנו" (דברים כו,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] states: "I have not eaten from it while in mourning."

items.he: שלא להוציא דמי מעשר שני בשאר דברים שאין בהם אכילה ושתייה
items.en: Not to use the proceeds [from the redemption of] the second tithe for anything aside from food and drink
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא נתתי ממנו, למת" (דברים כו,יד); וכל שהוא חוץ לצורכי הגוף החי, "נתתי ממנו, למת" אקרא בו.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] states: "I have not used it for the dead." Anything that is not associated with the needs of a living body is referred to as "used for the dead."7Though the Rambam's statements are based on the Sifre, his interpretation of the verse appears to be original and not quoted from other sources.

items.he: שלא לאכול הטבל; והטבל הוא הדבר שגידוליו מן הארץ החייב בתרומות ומעשרות, שלא הוציאו ממנו תרומת ה': .שנאמר "ולא יחללו, את קודשי בני ישראל--את אשר ירימו, לה'" (ויקרא כב,טו); כלומר, דברים שהם עתידין להרים אותם לה', לא יעשו אותם חול ויאכלו אותם בטבלם
items.en: Not to eat tevel. Tevel refers to produce from which one is obligated to separate terumah and tithes from which God's terumah has not been separated
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 22:15] states: "And they shall not profane the sacred gifts which the children of Israel will separate for God." This implies that the produce which [the Jews] will ultimately separate for God should not be treated in a mundane manner and eaten while tevel.

items.he: שלא להקדים תרומה לביכורים, ולא מעשר ראשון לתרומה, ולא מעשר שני לראשון, אלא מוציאין על הסדר: .ביכורים תחילה, ואחר כך תרומה גדולה, ואחר כך מעשר ראשון, ואחר כך מעשר שני;
items.en: Not to separate terumah before the first fruits, nor the first tithe before terumah, nor the second tithe before the first. Rather, [the agricultural gifts] must be given in order - first, the first fruits; afterwards, terumah; afterwards, the first tithe; and, afterwards, the second tithe -
items.srcHe: שנאמר "מלאתך ודמעך, לא תאחר" (שמות כב,כח), כלומר לא תאחר דבר הראוי להקדימו.
items.srcEn: as [implied by Exodus 22:28]: "Do not delay your offerings of newly ripened produce and your agricultural offerings." [This means:] Do not delay bringing an offering that should be brought first.

items.he: שלא לאחר הנדרים והנדבות שנדר ושנדב
items.en: Not to delay bringing sacrifices you have vowed to offer, or animals which you have pledged to bring as sacrifices
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תאחר לשלמו" (דברים כג,כב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:22] states: "[When you make a pledge to God,] do not delay paying it."

items.en: Not to make a festive pilgrimage without [bringing] a sacrifice
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא ייראו פניי, ריקם" (שמות כג,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:15] states: "Do not appear before Me empty-handed."

items.he: שלא לעבור על דברים שאסר אדם על נפשו
items.en: Not to violate a vow which a person makes forbidding his use of anything
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יחל, דברו" (במדבר ל,ג).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 30:3] states: "He shall not violate his word."

items.en: For a priest not to marry an immoral woman [zonah]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אישה זונה וחללה לא ייקחו" (ויקרא כא,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:7] states: "They shall not marry an immoral woman or a chalalah."

items.en: For a priest not to marry a chalalah,8A chalalah is a woman who engaged in sexual relations with a priest when she was forbidden to do so, or a woman who was conceived from such relations (Hilchot Issurei Bi'ah 19:1)
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וחללה לא ייקחו" (ויקרא כא,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:7] states: "They shall not marry... a chalalah."

items.en: For a priest not to marry a divorcee
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ואישה גרושה מאישה לא ייקחו" (ויקרא כא,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:7] states: "...nor may they marry a woman divorced from her husband."

items.en: For a High Priest not to marry a widow
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אלמנה וגרושה וחללה זונה, את אלה לא ייקח" (ויקרא כא,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:14] states: "A widow, a divorcee, a chalalah, or an immoral woman - these he must not marry."

items.he: שלא יבעול כוהן גדול אלמנה, ואפילו בלא קידושים, מפני שמחללה
items.en: For a High Priest not to have sexual relations with a widow even outside the context of marriage, because by doing so he profanes her
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יחלל זרעו, בעמיו" (ויקרא כא,טו); הרי הוא מוזהר שלא לחלל כשרה.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:15] states: "He shall not profane his progeny...." This [also] implies that he must not cause a woman eligible to marry a priest to become ineligible [as happens through the relations described above].

items.he: שלא ייכנס כוהן למקדש פרוע ראש
items.en: For a priest not to enter the Temple with hair that has grown unseemingly long
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ראשיכם אל תפרעו" (ויקרא י,ו).
items.srcEn: as [implied by Leviticus 10:6]: "Do not let your hair grow long."

items.he: שלא ייכנס כוהן למקדש קרוע בגדים
items.en: For a priest not to enter the Temple with torn garments
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ובגדיכם לא תפרומו" (ויקרא י,ו).
items.srcEn: as [implied by Leviticus, ibid.]: "Do not rend your garments."

items.he: שלא ייצא כוהן מן העזרה בשעת עבודה
items.en: For a priest not to leave the Temple courtyard in the midst of service
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ומפתח אוהל מועד לא תצאו" (ויקרא י,ז).
items.srcEn: as [implied by Leviticus 10:7]: "Do not depart from before the entrance to the Tent of Testimony."

items.he: שלא ייטמא כוהן הדיוט לשאר מתים
items.en: For a common priest not to become impure through contact with a corpse [with the exception of the specific instances permitted by the Torah]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לנפש לא ייטמא בעמיו" (ויקרא כא,א).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:1] states: "He shall not become impure [through contact with] the dead."

items.he: שלא ייטמא כוהן גדול ואפילו לקרוביו
items.en: For a High Priest not to become impure [through contact with any corpse], even [those of] his relatives
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לאביו ולאימו, לא ייטמא" (ויקרא כא,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:11] states: "He shall not become impure, [even] for his father and mother."

items.he: שלא ייכנס כוהן גדול עם מת
items.en: For a High Priest not to enter the place where a corpse is found
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ועל כל נפשות מת, לא יבוא" (ויקרא כא,יא); כך למדו מפי השמועה, שהוא חייב בבל יבוא וחייב בבל ייטמא.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:11] states: "He should not come in contact with any dead body." According to the oral tradition, we have learned that he is obligated [for violating both the prohibitions:] not to become impure and not to enter [the place of a corpse].

items.he: שלא ייקח כל שבט לוי חלק בארץ
items.en: For the tribe of Levi not to take a portion of Eretz Yisrael
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ונחלה לא יהיה לו" (דברים יח,ב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 18:2] states: "He shall not receive an inheritance."

items.he: שלא ייקח כל שבט לוי חלק בביזה בשעת כיבוש הארץ
items.en: For the tribe of Levi not to take a portion of the spoils in the conquest of Eretz Yisrael
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יהיה לכוהנים הלויים . . . חלק ונחלה" (דברים יח,א).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 18:1] states: "The priests and the Levites shall not receive a portion or an inheritance."

items.en: Not to tear out hair [in mourning] for the dead
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תשימו קורחה בין עיניכם--למת" (דברים יד,א).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 14:1] states: "Do not make a bald spot upon your heads."

items.en: Not to eat non-kosher animals
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אך את זה, לא תאכלו, ממעלי הגרה" (ויקרא יא,ד; דברים יד,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 14:7] states: "Nevertheless, among those who chew the cud, these you may not eat...."

items.en: Not to eat non-kosher fish
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ושקץ, יהיו לכם; מבשרם לא תאכלו" (ויקרא יא,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 11:11] states: "They shall be [regarded as] a detestable thing for you. Do not eat of their flesh."

items.en: Not to eat non-kosher birds
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ואת אלה תשקצו מן העוף, לא ייאכלו" (ויקרא יא,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 11:13] states: "These birds you must regard as detestable. Do not eat them."

items.en: Not to eat flying insects
items.srcHe: שנאמר "כול שרץ העוף, טמא הוא לכם" (דברים יד,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 14:19] states: "Every flying insect [that is] not-kosher for you shall not be eaten."

items.en: Not to eat insects that breed on land
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וכל השרץ, השורץ על הארץ--שקץ הוא, לא ייאכל" (ויקרא יא,מא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 11:41] states: "Every insect that creeps upon the earth must be regarded as detestable. It may not be eaten."

items.en: Not to eat anything that creeps on the earth
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תטמאו את נפשותיכם, בכל השרץ הרומש על הארץ" (ויקרא יא,מד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 11:44] states: "Do not make your souls impure with any insect that creeps upon the earth."

items.he: שלא לאכול תולעת הפירות כשתצא לאוויר
items.en: Not to eat worms that breed in produce after they become exposed to the air
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לכל השרץ, השורץ על הארץ--לא תאכלום" (ויקרא יא,מב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 11:42] states: "...for any swarming creature which breeds upon the land, you shall not eat them."

items.en: Not to eat swarming creatures that breed in the water
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אל תשקצו, את נפשותיכם, בכל השרץ" (ויקרא יא,מג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 11:43] states: "Do not make yourselves detestable [by eating] any swarming creature."

items.en: Not to eat carrion
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תאכלו כל נבילה" (דברים יד,כא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 14:21] states: "Do not eat carrion."

items.en: Not to eat an animal with a mortal infliction (trefah)
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ובשר בשדה טריפה לא תאכלו" (שמות כב,ל).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:30] states: "Do not eat flesh torn off [by a predator]."

items.en: Not to eat a limb from a living animal
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תאכל הנפש, עם הבשר" (דברים יב,כג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 12:23] states: "Do not eat the life [of an animal] with its flesh."

items.en: Not to eat the displaced [sciatic] nerve
items.srcHe: שנאמר "על כן לא יאכלו בני ישראל את גיד הנשה" (בראשית לב,לג).
items.srcEn: as [Genesis 32:33] states: "Therefore, the children of Israel do not eat the displaced nerve."

items.en: Not to consume blood
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וכל דם, לא תאכלו" (ויקרא ג,יז; ויקרא ז,כו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 7:26] states: "Do not consume any blood."

items.en: Not to partake of [hard] fat
items.srcHe: שנאמר "כל חלב שור וכשב, ועז--לא תאכלו" (ויקרא ז,כג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 7:23] states: "Do not eat any of the fat in an ox, sheep, or goat."

items.en: Not to cook meat and milk [together]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תבשל גדי, בחלב אימו" (שמות כג,יט; שמות לד,כו; דברים יד,כא).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:19] states: "Do not cook a kid in its mother's milk."

items.en: Not to eat meat and milk [together]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תבשל גדי, בחלב אימו" פעם שנייה (שמות לד,כו); כך למדו מפי השמועה, שאחד לאיסור בישול ואחד לאיסור אכילה.
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 34:26] states: "Do not cook a kid in its mother's milk." Based on the oral tradition, we have learned that one [of these verses] implies a prohibition against cooking [the two together], and the other, a prohibition against eating [from the combination].

items.en: Not to partake of the meat of an ox that was stoned to death
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא ייאכל את בשרו" (שמות כא,כח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 21:28] states: "And do not eat its flesh."

items.he: שלא לאכול פת תבואה חדשה קודם הפסח
items.en: Not to eat bread made from newly grown produce before Pesach
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולחם . . . לא תאכלו" (ויקרא כג,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:14] states: "[Until that day,...] you may not eat bread..."

items.en: Not to eat roasted grain from newly grown produce before Pesach
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וקלי . . . לא תאכלו" (ויקרא כג,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] continues: "[Until that day,...] you may not eat... roasted grain..."

items.en: Not to eat fresh grain from newly grown produce before Pesach
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וכרמל לא תאכלו" (ויקרא כג,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] continues: "[Until that day,...] you may not eat... fresh grain."

items.en: Not to eat orlah for three years
items.srcHe: שנאמר "שלוש שנים, יהיה לכם ערלים--לא ייאכל" (ויקרא יט,כג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:23] states: "For three years, you must regard its fruit as a forbidden growth. It may not be eaten."

items.en: Not to eat mixed species planted in a vineyard
items.srcHe: שנאמר "פן תקדש, המלאה הזרע אשר תזרע, ותבואת, הכרם" (דברים כב,ט); זה הוא איסור אכילה.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:9] states: "...lest the yield of the crops you planted and the fruit of the vineyard shall become forfeit." This refers to a prohibition against eating [such produce].

items.en: Not to drink wine used for idolatrous libations
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אשר חלב זבחימו יאכלו, ישתו יין נסיכם" (דברים לב,לח).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 32:38] states: "...who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their libations."

items.he: שלא לאכול ולשתות דרך זולל וסובא
items.en: Not to eat or drink like a glutton and a drunkard
items.srcHe: שנאמר "בננו זה . . . זולל, וסובא" (דברים כא,כ).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 21:20] states: "This son of ours is a glutton and a drunkard."9Note that in Hilchot Mamrim 7:1, where the Rambam discusses this prohibition, he quotes a different prooftext.

items.en: Not to eat on the day of the fast [of Yom Kippur]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "כי כל הנפש אשר לא תעונה" (ויקרא כג,כט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:29] states: "For any person who does not afflict himself [on that day]...."

items.en: Not to partake of chametz on Pesach
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא ייאכל, חמץ" (שמות יג,ג).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 13:3] states: "Do not eat chametz."

items.en: Not to eat a mixture of chametz
items.srcHe: שנאמר "כל מחמצת, לא תאכלו" (שמות יב,כ).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 12:20] states: "Do not eat any leavened matter."

items.he: שלא לאכול חמץ אחר חצות יום ארבעה עשר
items.en: Not to eat chametz after noontime on the fourteenth [of Nisan]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תאכל עליו חמץ" (דברים טז,ג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 16:3] states: "Do not eat chametz with it."

items.en: Not to have chametz seen [in one's possession during Pesach]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא ייראה לך חמץ" (שמות יג,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 13:7] states: "No chametz and no leaven may be seen in your territories."

items.en: Not to have chametz found [in one's possession during Pesach]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "שאור, לא יימצא בבתיכם" (שמות יב,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 13:7] states: "No chametz may be found in your homes."

items.he: שלא ישתה הנזיר יין, ולא דבר שנתערב בו יין וטעמו כטעם יין
items.en: For a Nazarite not to drink wine or partake of anything in which wine was mixed and has the taste of wine
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וכל משרת ענבים" (במדבר ו,ג); ואפילו החמיץ היין או דבר שנתערב בו היין, הרי זה אסור עליו, שנאמר "חומץ יין וחומץ שיכר לא ישתה" (שם).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 6:3] states: "He shall not drink any grape beverage." [This prohibition applies] even if the wine or other beverage with which the wine was mixed has become sour, as the above verse states: "He may not drink vinegar from wine or wine-brandy."

items.en: [For a Nazarite] not to eat fresh grapes
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וענבים לחים . . . לא יאכל" (במדבר ו,ג).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers, ibid.] states: "[He shall not eat] fresh... grapes."

items.en: [For a Nazarite] not to eat raisins
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ויבשים לא יאכל" (במדבר ו,ג).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers, ibid.] states: "[He shall not eat]... dried grapes."

items.en: [For a Nazarite] not to eat grape seeds
items.srcHe: שנאמר "מחרצנים . . . לא יאכל" (במדבר ו,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 6:4] states: "He shall not eat [anything from wine grapes] from its seeds...."

items.en: [For a Nazarite] not to eat grape peels
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ועד זג--לא יאכל" (במדבר ו,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers, ibid.] continues: "He shall not eat [anything from wine grapes,...] to its peels."

items.en: For a Nazarite not to become impure through contact with a dead body
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לאביו ולאימו . . . לא ייטמא להם, במותם" (במדבר ו,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 6:7] states: "He may not become impure even for his father, his mother,...."

items.en: [For a Nazarite] not to enter below any roof beneath which a corpse is found
items.srcHe: שנאמר "על נפש מת, לא יבוא" (במדבר ו,ו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 21:11] states: "He shall not come into contact with any dead body."10Though this prooftext is quoted in the printed editions of the Mishneh Torah, it appears to be an error, because the passage it introduces deals with the prohibition against a High Priest's coming into contact with a corpse. Perhaps the intended prooftext is Numbers 6:6, "he may not have contact with the dead."

items.en: [For a Nazarite] not to shave
items.srcHe: שנאמר "תער לא יעבור על ראשו" (במדבר ו,ה).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 6:5] states: "A razor shall not pass upon his head."

items.en: Not to harvest one's entire field
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תכלה פאת שדך בקוצרך" (ויקרא כג,כב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:22] states: "Do not completely harvest the ends of your fields."

items.he: שלא ללקוט השיבולים הנופלות בשעת קצירה
items.en: Not to gather the [individual] stalks that fall in the harvest
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולקט קצירך, לא תלקט" (ויקרא יט,ט; ויקרא כג,כב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] states: "Do not gather the leket of your harvest."

items.en: Not to harvest underdeveloped grape clusters
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וכרמך לא תעולל" (ויקרא יט,י).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:10] states: "Do not pick the incompletely formed grape clusters in your vine-yard."

items.en: Not to gather individual [fallen grapes]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ופרט כרמך לא תלקט" (ויקרא יט,י).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] states: "Do not gather the individual [fallen grapes] in your vineyard."

items.en: Not to take a sheaf which has been forgotten
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תשוב לקחתו" (דברים כד,יט); וכן לכל האילנות יש שכחה, שנאמר "לא תפאר אחריך" (דברים כד,כ).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:19] states: "Do not go back to take it." [This prohibition also applies to] all trees, as [ibid. 24:20] states: "Do not carefully re-harvest it."

items.en: Not to sow mixed species of seeds together
items.srcHe: שנאמר "שדך לא תזרע כלאיים" (ויקרא יט,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:19] states: "Do not sow different species of seed in your field."

items.he: שלא לזרוע תבואה או ירק בכרם
items.en: Not to sow grain or vegetables in a vineyard
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תזרע כרמך, כלאיים" (דברים כב,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:9] states: "Do not plant different species in your vineyard."

items.he: שלא להרביע בהמה מין בשאינו מינו
items.en: Not to crossbreed different species of animals
items.srcHe: שנאמר "בהמתך לא תרביע כלאיים" (ויקרא יט,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:19] states: "Do not crossbreed your livestock with other species."

items.he: שלא יעשה מלאכה בשני מיני בהמה כאחד
items.en: Not to work with two different species of animals together
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תחרוש בשור ובחמור, יחדיו" (דברים כב,י).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:10] states: "Do not plow with an ox and a donkey together."

items.he: שלא לחסום בהמה בשעת מלאכה בדבר שאוכלת ממנו ונהנית
items.en: Not to muzzle an ox while it is working with produce from which it would eat and derive benefit
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תחסום שור, בדישו" (דברים כה,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 25:4] states: "Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading grain."

items.en: Not to cultivate the land in the seventh year
items.srcHe: שנאמר "שדך לא תזרע" (ויקרא כה,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:4] states: "Do not sow your field."

items.en: Not to cultivate trees in the seventh year
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וכרמך לא תזמור" (ויקרא כה,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] continues: "Do not prune your vineyard."

items.he: שלא לקצור ספיחי שביעית כדרך שקוצרין בשאר השנים
items.en: Not to reap crops that grow on their own in the seventh year in the same manner as in an ordinary year
items.srcHe: שנאמר "את ספיח קצירך לא תקצור" (ויקרא כה,ה).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:5] states: "Do not reap the crops of your harvest that grow on their own."

items.he: שלא לאסוף פירות האילן בשביעית כדרך שאוספין בכל שנה ושנה
items.en: Not to reap fruit that grows on trees in the seventh year in the same manner as in an ordinary year
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ואת עינבי נזיריך לא תבצור" (ויקרא כה,ה).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] continues: "...and do not gather the grapes of your vines from which you must abstain."

items.he: שלא לעבוד בשנת יובל בין אדמה בין אילן
items.en: Not to do [agricultural] work - whether with land or trees - in the Jubilee year
items.srcHe: שנאמר בה "לא תזרעו" (ויקרא כה,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:11] states: "Do not sow...."

items.he: שלא לקצור ספיחי יובל כשאר השנים
items.en: Not to reap crops that grow on their own in the Jubilee year in the same manner as in an ordinary year
items.srcHe: שנאמר בו "לא תקצרו את ספיחיה" (ויקרא כה,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] states: "Do not harvest the crops which grow on their own."

items.he: שלא לאסוף פירות יובל כאסיפת שאר השנים
items.en: Not to reap the fruit of the Jubilee year in the same manner as in an ordinary year
items.srcHe: שנאמר בו "ולא תבצרו את נזיריה" (ויקרא כה,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] continues: "...and do not gather the grapes of your vines from which you must abstain."

items.he: שלא למכור שדה בארץ ישראל לצמיתות
items.en: Not to sell a field in Eretz Yisrael in perpetuity
items.srcHe: שנאמר "והארץ, לא תימכר לצמיתות" (ויקרא כה,כג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:23] states: "Do not make a permanent sale of the land."

items.en: Not to change [the purpose of] the open areas and fields [granted to] the Levites
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ושדה מגרש עריהם, לא יימכר" (ויקרא כה,לד); מפי השמועה למדו שזו אזהרה שלא ישתנה.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:34] states: "The fields of the open areas [surrounding] their cities shall not be sold." According to the oral tradition, we have learned that this verse is a prohibition against changing [the purpose for which these lands are used].

items.en: Not to forsake the Levites
items.srcHe: שנאמר "הישמר לך, פן תעזוב את הלוי" (דברים יב,יט), אלא נותנין להם מתנותיהם ומשמחים אותם בהן בכל רגל ורגל.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 12:19 states: "Be very careful not to abandon the Levite." Rather, we must give them the portions they are due and rejoice with them on each of the festivals.

items.he: שלא יתבע הלוואה שעברה עליה שביעית
items.en: Not to demand the repayment of a loan after the seventh year has passed
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא ייגוש את ריעהו ואת אחיו" (דברים טו,ב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 15:2] states: "Do not demand payment from your fellow man."

items.he: שלא יימנע מלהלוות לעני מפני השמיטה
items.en: Not to withhold lending money to a poor person because of the advent of the shemitah year
items.srcHe: שנאמר "הישמר לך פן יהיה דבר" (דברים טו,ט). .זה הכלל--כל מקום שנאמר הישמר או פן או אל, אינו אלא מצות לא תעשה.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 15:9] states "Be careful, lest an idea...[occur to you....]" This is an accepted general principle: Whenever [the Torah] uses the expressions "Be careful," "Lest," or "Do not," a negative commandment is involved.

items.he: שלא יימנע מלהחיות לעני ומליתן לו מה שהוא צריך
items.en: Not to withhold lending money to a poor person or providing him with his needs
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תאמץ את לבבך" (דברים טו,ז); נמצא הנותן צדקה עושה מצות עשה, והמעלים עיניו מן הצדקה יתר על שביטל עשה עבר על לא תעשה.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 15:7] states: "Do not harden your heart." Thus, a person who gives charity fulfills a positive commandment, while one who spurns the opportunity to give not only fails to perform a positive commandment, but also transgresses a negative commandment.

items.he: שלא לשלח עבד עברי ריקם כשייצא חופשי
items.en: Not to send away a Hebrew servant empty-handed when he goes free
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תשלחנו, ריקם" (דברים טו,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 15:13] states: "Do not send him away empty-handed."

items.he: שלא יתבע העני בחובו כשיידע שהוא עני, ולא יצר לו
items.en: Not to demand payment of a debt from a poor person when one knows that he is impoverished, nor to cause him grief
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תהיה לו, כנושה" (שמות כב,כד).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:24] states: "Do not behave like a creditor towards him."

items.en: Not to lend at interest to a Jew
items.srcHe: שנאמר "את כספך--לא תיתן לו, בנשך" (ויקרא כה,לז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:37] states: "Do not lend him your money at interest."

items.en: Not to borrow with interest
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תשיך לאחיך" (דברים כג,כ); כך למדו מפי השמועה, שזו אזהרה ללווה שלא יינשך למלווה.
items.srcEn: as [inferred from Deuteronomy 23:20, which] states: "Do not take interest from your brother." According to the oral tradition, this verse is interpreted as a prohibition, forbidding a borrower from paying interest to a lender.

items.he: שלא להשית יד בין לווה ומלווה בריבית, ולא להיות ערב, ולא עד, ולא לכתוב שטר ביניהם
items.en: Not to intermediate between the borrower and lender when interest is involved, not to act as a guarantor or a witness [to such a loan], nor to draw up a contract for it
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תשימון עליו, נשך" (שמות כב,כד).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:24] states: "Do not charge him interest."

items.en: Not to delay payment of a worker
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תלין פעולת שכיר, איתך" (ויקרא יט,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:13] states: "Do not hold back a worker's wages overnight."

items.en: Not to take security from a debtor by force
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תבוא אל ביתו, לעבוט עבוטו" (דברים כד,י).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:10] states: "Do not enter his home to take security."

items.he: שלא למנוע העבוט מבעליו העני בעת שהוא צריך לו
items.en: Not to withhold the return of security to its owner when he needs it
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תשכב, בעבוטו" (דברים כד,יב); כלומר, לא תשכב ועבוטו עימך, אלא תשיבנו לו בלילה, הואיל והוא צריך לו בלילה.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:12] states: "Do not lie down [to sleep] with his security" - i.e., do not lie down while holding his security. Instead, return it to him at night when he needs it at night.

items.en: Not to take security from a widow
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תחבול בגד אלמנה" (דברים כד, יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:17] states: "Do not take a widow's garment as security."

items.he: שלא לחבול כלים שעושין בהם אוכל נפש
items.en: Not to take utensils used in the preparation of food
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יחבול ריחיים, ורכב" (דברים כד,ו).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:6] states: "Do not take either the upper or lower millstone as a pledge."

items.en: Not to kidnap a Jewish person
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תגנוב" (שמות כ,יב; דברים ה,טז); זה גונב נפש.
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:13] states: "Do not steal." This refers to kidnapping.

items.en: Not to steal
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא, תגנובו" (ויקרא יט,יא); זו היא גניבת ממון.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:11] states: "Do not steal." This refers to stealing money.

items.en: Not to rob
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תגזול" (ויקרא יט,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:13] states: "Do not rob."

items.en: Not to alter land boundaries
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תסיג גבול ריעך" (דברים יט,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 19:14] states: "Do not remove your neighbor's landmark."

items.en: Not to wrong [a colleague by withholding his due]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תעשוק את ריעך" (ויקרא יט,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:13] states: "Do not wrong your neighbor."

items.en: Not to deny [a just claim]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תכחשו" (ויקרא יט,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:11] states: "Do not deny your neighbor's [claim]."

items.he: שלא לישבע על כפירת ממון חברו
items.en: Not to swear falsely in denying a monetary [obligation to] a colleague
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תשקרו" (ויקרא יט,יא); כלומר, לא תישבע על שקר בממון שיש לחברך בידך.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] states: "Do not swear [falsely]" - i.e., do not swear falsely about money owed to a colleague.

items.en: Not to cheat in business
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אל תונו, איש את אחיו" (ויקרא כה,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:14] states: "One man should not cheat his brother."

items.en: Not to hurt someone with words
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תונו איש את עמיתו" (ויקרא כה, יז); זו אונאת דברים.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:17] states: "And one man shall not wrong another." This [prohibition refers to] hurting someone with words.

items.en: Not to hurt a convert with words
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְגֵר לֹא תוֹנֶה" (שמות כב, כ).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:20] states: "And do not wrong a convert...."

items.he: שלא להונות את הגר במקח וממכר
items.en: Not to cheat a convert in business
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְלֹא תִלְחָצֶנּוּ" (שמות כב, כ).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus, ibid.] continues: "...nor oppress him."

items.he: שלא להחזיר עבד שברח לארץ ישראל לאדוניו שבחוצה לארץ
items.en: Not to return a slave who fled to Eretz Yisrael to his master [who lives] in the Diaspora
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תַסְגִּיר עֶבֶד אֶל אֲדוֹנָיו" (דברים כג, טז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:16] states: "Do not deliver a servant to his master."

items.en: Not to wrong such a servant
items.srcHe: שנאמר "עִמְּךָ יֵשֵׁב בְּקִרְבֶּךָ... בַּטּוֹב לוֹ לֹא תּוֹנֶנּוּ" (דברים כג, יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:17] states: "He shall dwell in your midst, in the place which he selects... as he sees fit. Do not wrong him."

items.en: Not to oppress any widow or orphan
items.srcHe: שנאמר "כָּל אַלְמָנָה וְיָתוֹם לֹא תְעַנּוּן" (שמות כב, כא).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:21] states: "Do not oppress any widow or orphan."

items.he: שלא לעבוד בעבד עברי כעבודת עבד
items.en: Not to have a Hebrew servant perform servile tasks
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תַעֲבֹד בּוֹ עֲבוֹדַת עָבֶד" (ויקרא כה, לט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:39] states: "Do not work him like a slave."

items.en: Not to sell [a Hebrew servant] as slaves are sold
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא יִמָּכְרוּ מִמְכֶּרֶת עָבֶד" (ויקרא כה, מב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:42] states: "Do not sell him as slaves are sold."

items.en: Not to make a Hebrew servant perform rigorous work
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תִרְדֶּה בּוֹ בְּפָרֶךְ" (ויקרא כה, מג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:43] states: "Do not rule over him with rigor."

items.he: שלא להניח הגוי לעבד בעבד עברי הנמכר לו בפרך
items.en: Not to allow a gentile [who purchased a Hebrew servant] to make him work rigorously
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא יִרְדֶּנּוּ בְּפָרֶךְ לְעֵינֶךָ" (ויקרא כה, נג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 25:53] states: "He shall not rule over him with rigor."

items.en: Not to sell a Hebrew maidservant to another person
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא יִמְשׁוֹל לְמָכְרָהּ בְּבִגְדוֹ בָהּ" (שמות כא, ח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 21:8] states: "He shall have no power to sell her."

items.he: שלא למנוע מאמה עברייה היעודה שאר כסות ועונה
items.en: Not to withhold from a Hebrew maidservant who has been designated as a bride living expenses, clothing, or conjugal rights
items.srcHe: שנאמר "שְׁאֵרָהּ כְּסוּתָהּ וְעוֹנָתָהּ לֹא יִגְרָע" (שמות כא, י); והוא הדין לשאר הנשים.
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 21:10] states: "He may not diminish her living expenses, clothing, or conjugal rights." The above applies also to other wives.

items.en: Not to sell a yefat to'ar, as a maidservant
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ומכור לא תמכרנה" (דברים כא, יד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 21:14] states: "Do not sell her."

items.he: שלא לכבוש אשת יפת תואר שפחה
items.en: Not to force a yefat to'ar to serve as a maidservant
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תִתְעַמֵּר בָּהּ" (דברים כא, יד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] continues: "Do not rule over her."

items.en: Not to covet
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תַחְמֹד אֵשֶׁת רֵעֶךָ" (שמות כ, יג).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:14] states: "Do not be envious of your neighbor's wife."

items.en: Not to desire
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תִתְאַוֶּה בֵּית רֵעֶךָ" (דברים ה, יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 5:18] states: "Do not desire your neighbor's house."

items.he: שלא יאכל השכיר שלא בשעת גמר מלאכה מן המחובר שהוא עושה בו
items.en: For a worker who is harvesting crops not to eat from the unpicked produce before he has finished work
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְחֶרְמֵשׁ לֹא תָנִיף" (דברים כג, כו).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:26] states: "Do not lift a sickle...."

items.he: שלא ייקח השכיר יתר על אכילתו
items.en: For a worker not to take more than what he eats [from the produce he harvests]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְאָכַלְתָּ עֲנָבִים כְּנַפְשְׁךָ שָׂבְעֶךָ" (דברים כג, כה).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 23:25] states: "Do not put any into your receptacles."

items.en: Not to ignore a lost object
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תוּכַל לְהִתְעַלֵּם" (דברים כב, ג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:3] states: "You may not ignore it."

items.he: שלא להניח הבהמה רובצת תחת משאה בדרך
items.en: Not to leave an animal fallen under its load on the road
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תִרְאֶה חֲמוֹר אָחִיךָ" (ראה דברים כב, ד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:4] states: "You may not watch your neighbor's donkey...."

items.en: Not to falsify measurements
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ עָוֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט בְּמִדָּה" (ויקרא יט, לה); מפי השמועה למדו שהכתוב מזהיר לא תעשו עול במשפט המדה.
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:35] states: "Do not act deceitfully in judgment...." According to the oral tradition, we have learned that this verse prohibits acting deceitfully regarding measurements.

items.he: שלא להיות אצלנו איפה ואיפה אבן ואבן
items.en: Not to possess two sets of weights and measures
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ בְּבֵיתְךָ אֵיפָה וְאֵיפָה" (דברים כה, יד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 25:13] states: "You may not have in your home...."

items.en: Not to act deceitfully in judgment
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ עָוֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט" (ויקרא יט, טו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:15] states: "Do not pervert justice."

items.en: Not to accept bribes
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְשֹׁחַד לֹא תִקָּח" (שמות כג, ח).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:8] states: "Do not take a bribe."

items.en: Not to honor a man of stature in judgment
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְלֹא תֶהְדַּר פְּנֵי גָּדוֹל" (ויקרא יט, טו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:15] states: "Do not show respect to a great man."

items.he: שלא יירא הדיין בדין מאדם רע
items.en: For a judge not to fear rendering [a just] judgment because of a wicked man
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תָגוּרוּ מִפְּנֵי אִישׁ" (דברים א, יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 1:17] states: "Do not fear anyone."

items.en: Not to have mercy on a poor person in judgment
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְדָל לֹא תֶהְדַּר בְּרִיבוֹ" (שמות כג, ג).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:3] states: "And do not favor a poor man in his cause."

items.en: Not to pervert judgment against a sinner
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תַטֶּה מִשְׁפַּט אֶבְיֹנְךָ" (שמות כג, ו); למדו מפי השמועה, שזה אביון במצוות.
items.srcEn: as [implied by Exodus 23:6, which] states: "Do not pervert the judgment of a poor person." This refers to someone who is poor with regard to [the observance of] the mitzvot.

items.he: שלא לרחם על המזיק בדיני קנסות
items.en: Not to have pity on a person who has caused damages in judgments concerning fines
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תָחוֹס עֵינְךָ" (דברים יט, כא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 25:12] states: "Let your eye not pity."

items.en: Not to pervert the justice due converts or orphans
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תַטֶּה מִשְׁפַּט גֵר יָתוֹם" (דברים כד, יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:17] states: "Do not pervert the judgment of a convert or an orphan."

items.he: שלא לשמוע מאחד מבעלי דינין ואין חברו עימו
items.en: Not to listen to one litigant in the absence of the other
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תִשָּׂא שֵׁמַע שָׁוְא" (שמות כג, א).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:1] states: "Do not hear a false report."

items.he: שלא לנטות אחרי רבים בדיני נפשות, אם היו המחייבין יתר על המזכין אחד
items.en: Not to render a conviction in a capital case when there is only a majority of one
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תִהְיֶה אַחֲרֵי רַבִּים לְרָעוֹת" (שמות כג, ב).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:2] states: "Do not follow the majority to do evil."

items.he: שלא ילמד חובה מי שלימד זכות תחילה בדיני נפשות
items.en: For a person who argued in favor of acquittal in a capital case not to argue for a conviction
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תענה על ריב, לנטות" (שמות כג, ב).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus, ibid.] states: "Do not speak up in a trial to influence...."

items.he: שלא למנות בדיינין אדם שאינו חכם בדברי תורה, אף על פי שהוא חכם בחכמות אחרות
items.en: Not to appoint as a judge a man who is unlearned in the Torah, even if he is learned in other disciplines
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תַכִּירוּ פָּנִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט" (דברים א, יז).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 1:17] states: "Do not show favoritism regarding judgment."

items.en: Not to give false testimony
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תַעֲנֶה בְּרֵעֲךָ עֵד שָׁקֶר" (שמות כ, יב).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:13] states: "Do not give false testimony against your neighbor."

items.en: For a sinner not to act as a witness
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אַל תָּשֶׁת יָדְךָ עִם רָשָׁע לִהְיוֹת עֵד חָמָס" (שמות כג, א).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:1] states: "Do not conspire with a wicked person to be a corrupt witness."

items.en: For a relative not to act as a witness
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא יוּמְתוּ אָבוֹת עַל בָּנִים" (דברים כד, טז); מפי השמועה למדו שלא יומתו אבות בעדות בנים, והוא הדין לשאר הקרובים.
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:16] states: "Fathers shall not die because of children." According to the oral tradition, we have learned [that the verse teaches that] fathers should not die through the testimony of [their] sons. The same law applies regarding other relatives.

items.he: שלא לכרות הדין על פי עד אחד
items.en: Not to render a decision based on the testimony of a single witness
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא יָקוּם עֵד אֶחָד בְּאִישׁ" (דברים יט, טו).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 19:15] states: "A single witness shall not rise up against a person."

items.en: Not to kill an innocent person
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תִּרְצָח" (שמות כ, יב; דברים ה, טז).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:13] states: "Do not murder."

items.he: שלא לחתוך הדין באומד הדעת, עד שיראו שני עדים גופו של דבר
items.en: Not to render a decision on the basis of a presumption, unless two witnesses observe the actual matter
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְנָקִי וְצַדִּיק אַל תַּהֲרֹג" (שמות כג, ז).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 23:7] states: "Do not slay the innocent and the righteous."

items.he: שלא יורה העד בדין שהעיד בו בדיני נפשות
items.en: For a witness not to render a decision in a capital case in which he testified
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְעֵד אֶחָד לֹא יַעֲנֶה בְּנֶפֶשׁ" (במדבר לה, ל).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 35:30] states: "One witness shall not testify in a capital case..."

items.he: שלא להרוג מחוייב הריגה קודם שיעמוד בדין
items.en: Not to execute a person liable for execution before he stands trial
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְלֹא יָמוּת הָרוֹצֵחַ עַד עָמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה" (במדבר לה, יב).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 35:12] states: "The murderer shall not die [until he stands before the congregation]."

items.he: שלא לחוס על הרודף, אלא הורגין אותו קודם שיגיע לנרדף ויהרגנו או יגלה ערוותו
items.en: Not to have pity on a pursuer. Rather, he should be killed before he kills or rapes the person he is pursuing
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְקַצּוֹתָה אֶת כַּפָּהּ לֹא תָחוֹס עֵינְךָ" (דברים כה, יב).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 25:12] states: "And you shall cut off her hand. Show no pity."

items.en: Not to punish a person forced [to commit a sin]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְלַנַּעֲרָה לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה דָּבָר" (דברים כב, כו).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:26] states: "Do not do anything to the maiden."

items.en: Not to take a ransom from a murderer
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תקחו כופר לנפש רוצח" (במדבר לה, לא).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 35:31] states: "Do not take a ransom for the life of a murderer."

items.he: שלא ליקח כופר בגלות רוצח בשגגה
items.en: Not to take a ransom in return for exile for a person who kills accidentally
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְלֹא תִקְחוּ כֹּפֶר לָנוּס אֶל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ" (במדבר לה, לב).
items.srcEn: as [Numbers 35:32] states: "And do not take a ransom [for having] to flee to his refuge city."

items.en: Not to neglect [a person] in mortal danger
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תַעֲמֹד עַל דַּם רֵעֶךָ" (ויקרא יט, טז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:16] states: "Do not stand still in the face of mortal danger."

items.en: Not to leave obstacles
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְלֹא תָשִׂים דָּמִים בְּבֵיתֶךָ" (דברים כב, ח).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:8] states: "...lest you bring blood upon your house."

items.en: Not to mislead an unsuspecting person
items.srcHe: שנאמר "וְלִפְנֵי עִוֵּר לֹא תִתֵּן מִכְשׁוֹל" (ויקרא יט, יד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:14] states: "Do not place a stumbling block before the blind."

items.en: Not to add lashes when whipping a person liable for such punishment
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא יוסיף: .פן יוסיף" (דברים כה,ג).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 25:3] states: "Do not add [lashes], lest by [giving him] this additional [punishment]...."

items.en: Not to gossip
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תלך רכיל בעמיך" (ויקרא יט,טז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:16] states: "Do not go around as a gossiper among your people."

items.en: Not to bear hatred in one's heart
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לֹא תִשְׂנָא אֶת אָחִיךָ בִּלְבָבֶךָ" (ויקרא יט, יז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:17] states: "Do not hate your brother in your heart."

items.en: Not to embarrass any Jewish person
items.srcHe: שנאמר "הוכח תוכיח את עמיתך, ולא תישא עליו חטא" (ויקרא יט,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] states: "You shall surely rebuke your neighbor and not bear a sin because of him."

items.en: Not to take revenge
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תיקום" (ויקרא יט,יח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:18] states: "Do not take revenge."

items.en: Not to bear a grudge
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תיטור" (ויקרא יט,יח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] states: "Do not bear a grudge."

items.en: Not to take a mother bird together with the young
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תיקח האם, על הבנים" (דברים כב,ו).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 22:6] states: "Do not take the mother bird together with the young."

items.en: Not to shave the hair around a bald spot brought about by tzara’at]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ואת הנתק, לא יגלח" (ויקרא יג,לג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 13:33] states: "And he shall not shave the bald spot."

items.en: Not to remove the signs of tzara’at
items.srcHe: שנאמר "הישמר בנגע הצרעת" (דברים כד,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:8] states: "Be very careful concerning signs of tzara’at."

items.en: Not to till or sow the land [around] a powerful river [at which atonement was made for an unsolved murder]
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אשר לא ייעבד בו, ולא ייזרע" (דברים כא,ד).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 21:4] states: "...which must never be tilled and never be sown."

items.en: Not to allow a sorcerer to live
items.srcHe: שנאמר "מכשפה, לא תחייה" (שמות כב,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:17] states: "Do not allow a witch to live."

items.he: שלא יתחייב חתן בדבר מצורכי רבים כל שנתו, כגון צבא ושמירת החומה וכיוצא בהן
items.en: For a groom not to be held liable for any type of public service - e.g., army, guarding the walls [of a city], and the like -
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא ייצא בצבא, ולא יעבור עליו לכל דבר" (דברים כד,ה).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 24:5] states: "He shall not go out to the army, nor be charged with any duties."

items.he: שלא להמרות על פי בית דין
items.en: Not to reject the authority of the court
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תסור, מכל הדבר" (ראה דברים יז,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 17:11] states: "Do not swerve from the word which they tell you."

items.he: שלא להוסיף על מצוות התורה, בין תורה שבכתב בין בפירושה שקיבלו על פה
items.en: Not to add to the mitzvot of the Torah. [This applies] both to the Written Law and to its explanation conveyed by the oral tradition
items.srcHe: שנאמר "את כל הדבר, אשר אנוכי מצווה אתכם--אותו תשמרו, לעשות: .לא תוסף עליו" (דברים יג,א).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy 13:1] states: "Carefully observe everything which I command you to do. Do not add to it."

items.en: Not to diminish from any of the mitzvot of the Torah
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ולא תגרע ממנו" (דברים יג,א).
items.srcEn: as [Deuteronomy, ibid.] continues: "...and do not diminish from it."

items.en: Not to curse a judge
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אלוהים, לא תקלל" (שמות כב,כז).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 22:27] states: "Do not curse judges."

items.he: שלא לקלל הנשיא, והוא המלך או ראש ישיבת ארץ ישראל
items.en: Not to curse a nasi - i.e., the king or the head of the academy in Eretz Yisrael -
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ונשיא בעמך, לא תאור" (שמות כב,כז).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus, ibid.] continues: "...and do not curse the nasi of your people."

items.en: Not to curse any other Jew
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תקלל חירש" (ויקרא יט,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 19:14] states: "Do not curse [even] a deaf-mute."

items.en: Not to curse one's father or mother
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ומקלל אביו ואימו, מות יומת" (שמות כא,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 21:17] states: "One who curses his father or mother shall surely die."

items.en: Not to strike one's father or mother
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ומכה אביו ואימו, מות יומת" (שמות כא,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 21:15] states: "One who strikes his father or mother shall surely die."

items.en: Not to work on the Sabbath
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תעשה כל מלאכה" (שמות כ,ט; דברים ה,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 20:10] states: "Do not do any work."

items.he: שלא להלך חוץ לתחום מדינה כהולכי דרכים בשבת
items.en: Not to travel beyond the boundaries of a city on the Sabbath as travelers do
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אל ייצא איש ממקומו" (שמות טז,כט).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 16:29] states: "A person should not leave his place [on the Sabbath day]."

items.en: [For a court] not to inflict punishment on the Sabbath
items.srcHe: שנאמר "לא תבערו אש, בכול מושבותיכם" (שמות לה,ג).
items.srcEn: as [Exodus 35:3] states: "Do not kindle a fire on the Sabbath day."

items.he: שלא לעשות מלאכה בראשון של פסח
items.en: Not to work on the first day of Pesach
items.srcHe: שנאמר "כל מלאכה, לא ייעשה בהם" (שמות יב,טז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:7] states concerning it: "Do not do any servile11The term "servile work" refers to any of the labors forbidden on the Sabbath which are not associated with the preparation of food. work on these [days]."

items.he: שלא לעשות מלאכה בשביעי של פסח
items.en: Not to work on the seventh day of Pesach
items.srcHe: שנאמר "כל מלאכה, לא ייעשה בהם" (שמות יב,טז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:8] states concerning it: "Do not do any servile work on these [days]."

items.en: Not to work on the holiday of Shavuot
items.srcHe: שנאמר בו "כל מלאכת עבודה, לא תעשו" (ויקרא כג,כא; במדבר כח,כו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:21] states concerning it: "Do not do any servile work."

items.he: שלא לעשות מלאכה באחד לחודש השביעי
items.en: Not to work on the first day of the seventh month [the day of Rosh HaShanah]
items.srcHe: שנאמר בו "כל מלאכת עבודה, לא תעשו" (ויקרא כג,כה; במדבר כט,א).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:25] states concerning it: "Do not do any servile work."

items.en: Not to work on Yom Kippur
items.srcHe: שנאמר בו "כל מלאכה, לא תעשו" (ויקרא טז,כט; ויקרא כג,כח; ויקרא כג,לא; במדבר כט,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:28] states concerning it: "Do not do any servile12The verse is quoted in the above manner in the published texts of the Mishneh Torah. There is, however, a printing error, for on Yom Kippur the Torah forbids all work, even those labors involved in the preparation of food. work."

items.he: שלא לעשות מלאכה בראשון של חג
items.en: Not to work on the first day of the festival [of Sukkot]
items.srcHe: שנאמר בו "כל מלאכת עבודה, לא תעשו" (ויקרא כג,לה; ויקרא כג,לו; במדבר כט,יב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:35] states concerning it: "Do not do any servile work."

items.he: שלא לעשות מלאכה ביום שמיני של חג
items.en: Not to work on the eighth day of the festival [of Sukkot]
items.srcHe: שנאמר בו "כל מלאכת עבודה, לא תעשו" (ויקרא כג,לו; במדבר כט,לה).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 23:36] states concerning it: "Do not do any servile work."

items.en: Not to have intimate relations with one's mother
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אימך היא, לא תגלה ערוותה" (ויקרא יח,ז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:7] states: "She is your mother, do not commit incest with her."

items.en: Not to have intimate relations with one's father's wife
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ערוות אשת אביך, לא תגלה" (ויקרא יח,ח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:8] states: "Do not commit incest with your father's wife."

items.en: Not to have intimate relations with one's sister
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ערוות אחותך . . . לא תגלה" (ויקרא יח,ט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:9] states: "Do not commit incest with your sister, your father's daughter."

items.he: שלא לגלות ערוות אחות מן האב ומן האם
items.en: Not to have intimate relations with a sister,13Sefer HaMitzvot notes that this prohibition is almost identical with Negative Mitzvah 331, and explains that the Torah forbids such relations with two separate commands so that a person who commits such a sin will be held liable on two counts. [the daughter of] either your father or your mother
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ערוות בת אשת אביך מולדת אביך, אחותך היא--לא תגלה, ערוותה" (ויקרא יח,יא).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:11] states: "She is the daughter of your father, your father's progeny, do not commit incest with her."

items.en: Not to have intimate relations with one's son's daughter
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ערוות בת בנך" (ויקרא יח,י).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:10] states: "[Do not commit] incest with your son's daughter."

items.en: Not to have intimate relations with one's daughter's daughter
items.srcHe: שנאמר "או בת בתך, לא תגלה ערוותן" (ויקרא יח,י).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] continues: "...and do not commit incest with your daughter's daughter."

items.he: שלא לגלות ערוות הבת; ולמה לא נתפרשה בתורה, מפני שאסר בת הבת שתק מן הבת, ומפי השמועה למדו שאיסור הבת מגופי תורה, כשאר עריות
items.en: Not to have intimate relations with one's daughter. Why was this prohibition not explicitly stated in the Torah? Since the Torah forbade [relations with] one's daughter's daughter, it did not mention [the prohibition against relations with] one's daughter. [Nevertheless, according to the oral tradition, the prohibition against [relations with] one's daughter has the status of a Torah law like the other sexual offences [and is not considered as Rabbinic in origin].14As mentioned in note 15, in Sefer HaMitzvot (General Principle 2), the Rambam states that all of the 613 mitzvot are explicitly mentioned in the Torah and are not dependent on the exegesis of a verse according to the oral tradition. Therefore, in Sefer HaMitzvot, he elaborates in the explanation why this prohibition can be considered a negative commandment of the Torah even though the Torah does not explicitly mention it
Not to have intimate relations with a woman and her daughter
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ערוות אישה ובתה, לא תגלה" (ויקרא יח,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:17] states: "Do not commit incest [by marrying] a woman and her daughter."

items.he: שלא לגלות ערוות אישה ובת בנה
items.en: Not to have intimate relations with a woman and her son's daughter
items.srcHe: שנאמר "את בת בנה" (ויקרא יח,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] continues: "...her son's daughter...."

items.he: שלא לגלות ערוות אישה ובת בתה
items.en: Not to have intimate relations with a woman and her daughter's daughter
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ואת בת בתה, לא תיקח" (ויקרא יח,יז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus, ibid.] continues: "...her daughter's daughter,... you shall not take."

items.en: Not to have intimate relations with one's father's sister
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ערוות אחות אביך, לא תגלה" (ויקרא יח,יב).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:12] states: "Do not commit incest with your father's sister."

items.en: Not to have intimate relations with one's mother's sister
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ערוות אחות אימך, לא תגלה" (ויקרא יח,יג).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:13] states: "Do not commit incest with your mother's sister."

items.he: שלא לגלות ערוות אשת אחי האב
items.en: Not to have intimate relations with the wife of one's father's brother
items.srcHe: שנאמר "אל אשתו לא תקרב, דודתך היא" (ויקרא יח,יד).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:14] states: "Do not commit incest with his wife. [She is your aunt.]"

items.en: Not to have intimate relations with one's son's wife
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ערוות כלתך, לא תגלה" (ויקרא יח,טו).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:15] states: "Do not commit incest with your daughter-in-law."

items.en: Not to have intimate relations with one's brother's wife
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ערוות אשת אחיך, לא תגלה" (ויקרא יח,טז).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:16] states: "Do not commit incest with your brother's wife."

items.en: Not to have intimate relations with one's wife's sister
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ואישה אל אחותה, לא תיקח" (ויקרא יח,יח).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:18] states: "Do not take a woman as a wife together with her sister."

items.en: Not to have intimate relations with a woman in the niddah state
items.srcHe: שנאמר "ואל אישה, בנידת טומאתה--לא תקרב" (ויקרא יח,יט).
items.srcEn: as [Leviticus 18:19] states: "Do not come close to a woman in the niddah state of impurity."
